At Bombardier, we design, build and maintain the world’s peak\-performing aircraft for the world’s most discerning people and businesses, governments and militaries. We have been successful in setting the highest standards by putting our people at the heart of it all, and defining excellence, together.

* Insurance plans *(Dental, medical, life insurance, disability, and more)*
* Competitive base salary
* Retirement savings plan
* Employee Assistance Program
* Tele Health Program

* Design, build, test, deploy, and support secure applications and APIs from proof of concept through production.

* Integrate solutions with incumbent enterprise systems and approved platforms, including Azure, Databricks, SAP S/4HANA, SharePoint, Microsoft Graph, Power BI, and related APIs or services.

* Maintain architecture, operational, security, and support documentation.

* You hold a bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related field.
* You have 3\+ years of experience in cloud\-native software development.
* You are proficient in TypeScript/JavaScript and Python.
* You possess programming experience with React or an equivalent modern front\-end framework.

jobs.description:
**Req ID:** 388633
  
  

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward\-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  

We are currently seeking a technicien support informatique / Desktop Support Technician to join our team in Dorval, Quebec (CA\-QC), Canada (CA).
  
  

Nous sommes à la recherche d’un technicien support informatique pour notre équipe à Montréal, au Québec.
  
  

L’analyste technique des services sur place assurera le soutien et l’entretien dans l’environnement informatique de bureau de l’organisation. Ces tâches comprennent l’installation, le diagnostic et l’entretien de tout l’équipement de bureau, des imprimantes, des applications logicielles et des appareils mobiles afin d’assurer un rendement optimal. Le soutien sera offert en personne (utilisateurs sur place) ou par téléphone ou à distance (utilisateurs hors site).
  
  

Responsabilités
  
– Assurer le bon fonctionnement quotidien des applications et de l’équipement technologiques en repérant, en recherchant et en réglant les problèmes techniques.
  
– Apporter de l’aide sur place pour résoudre les problèmes technologiques et assurer le transfert de connaissances aux utilisateurs finaux sur une variété de questions liées à l’informatique.
  
– Effectuer les déménagements, les installations et les annulations prévus, ainsi que d’autres tâches liées au MAC.
  
– Fournir un soutien de niveau II de qualité aux utilisateurs ayant un degré élevé de satisfaction de la clientèle, des connaissances techniques et une rapidité d’exécution, soit en réglant le problème, soit en transmettant et en coordonnant les efforts d’autres membres du personnel des technologies de l’information.
  
– Résoudre les problèmes techniques et/ou enquêter sur les problèmes importants en confirmant la validité du problème et en recherchant des solutions connues aux problèmes ou enjeux plus complexes. Le candidat ou la candidate doit savoir à quel moment transmettre à la direction les problèmes non réglés à ce niveau.
  
– Utiliser la plateforme ServiceNow pour le suivi des problèmes, en veillant à ce que toutes les demandes d’aide des utilisateurs soient accompagnées d’un billet et que tous les incidents nécessitant un suivi ou des appels reçoivent l’attention appropriée.
  
– S’assurer que tous les incidents sont réglés dans le respect des niveaux de service documentés.
  
– Interagir avec les services de gestion des actifs, de réseau, d’ingénierie des systèmes logiciels, de mise au point d’applications et/ou d’entretien des imprimantes pour rétablir le service et/ou cerner et corriger le problème de base.
  
– Contribuer à l’élaboration et à la documentation des améliorations apportées aux processus actuels, à la création et à la mise à jour des capitaux de connaissances et des procédures normales d’exploitation.
  
– Posséder d’excellentes compétences en matière de présentation, de communication orale et de communication écrite.
  
– Apporter un soutien pour la mise à niveau technique, au besoin.
  
– Toutes les autres tâches qui lui sont confiées.
  
  

Compétences
  
  

– Plus de cinq ans d’expérience du soutien aux utilisateurs finaux et du soutien bureautique.
  
  

– Plus de cinq ans d’expérience du système d’exploitation Windows, de l’installation locale et de réseau, d’Internet Explorer, du protocole TCP/IP, du protocole DHCP, du gestionnaire de dispositifs, de l’éditeur du registre, du gestionnaire des utilisateurs et des commandes administratives.
  
  

We are currently seeking a Desktop Support Technician to join our team.
  
  

The Field tech Analyst will provide support and maintenance within the organization's desktop computing environment. This includes installing, diagnosing, and maintaining all desktop equipment, printers, software applications and mobile devices to ensure optimal performance. Support will be performed in person (on\-site users) or via telephone/remote control (off\-site users).
  
  

Responsibilities
  
* Ensure proper day\-to\-day operation of technology applications and equipment by identifying, researching and resolving technical problems.
* Provide deskside assistance to resolve technology issues and provide how\-to knowledge transfer to end users on a variety of computer\-related issues.
* Perform scheduled moves, installations, and cancellations, as well as other MAC\-related tasks.
* Provide quality level II support for users with a high degree of customer satisfaction, technical knowledge and timeliness either by resolving the issue or escalating and coordinating efforts of other Information Technology staff.
* Solve technical issues and/or investigate elevated issues by confirming the validity of the problem and seeking known solutions to more complex problems or issues. Must know when to escalate issues not resolved at this level to management.
* Utilize ServiceNow for issue tracking, ensuring all user requests for assistance are accompanied by a ticket and all tickets requiring follow\-up work and/or calls receive appropriate attention.
* Ensure all tickets are resolved within documented service levels.
* Interact with asset management, network services, software systems engineering, applications development and/or printer maintenance services to restore service and/or identify and correct core problem.
* Assist in developing and documenting improvements to current processes, creating/updating KAs and SOPs.
* Possess excellent presentation, verbal communication and written skills.
* Provide technology refresh support as needed.
* All other tasks as assigned.


Qualifications
  
  

* 5\+ years of experience with end user support desktop support.
* 5\+ years of experience with Windows operating system, local/network installation, Internet explorer, TCP/IP, DHCP, Device Manager, Registry editor, User Manager Admin Commands.

**About AlayaCare**
-------------------



At AlayaCare, we're more than just a fast\-growing SaaS company, we're a team of people passionate about transforming home healthcare. Our cloud\-based platform empowers care providers around the world to deliver better outcomes for their clients. With 600\+ employees across Canada, the US, Australia, and Brazil, we're united by a shared mission and a strong culture of transparency, growth, and human connection. Whether you're early in your career or a seasoned expert, AlayaCare offers the opportunity to grow your impact, your skills, and your career.


**About the Role**
------------------



Reporting to the Associate Director of Professional Services, the Professional Services Consultant plays a critical, customer\-facing and internal role in enabling the growth of a best\-in\-class professional services organization. This role is responsible for the successful delivery and execution of professional services\-led implementations and projects. Leading both customer and internal stakeholders, you'll bring subject matter expertise in specific functional areas (AlayaCare Platform, Home Care industry) that drives value into project deliverables. You'll manage complex components of engagements, working closely with customers to understand pain points and achieve positive outcomes, and you'll own the quality of project delivery and the reporting of customer outcomes. This is an individual contributor role that gains seniority through ongoing specialization.


**What You'll Do**
------------------


* Lead teams through the Discovery phase, including project requirements gathering, workflow design, configuration, reports, testing, and user training
* Serve as a trusted advisor to customers, supporting customer issues as they arise and looping in the project manager when issues may impact project scope, timeline, or budget
* Partner with Account Managers to ensure a smooth transition for customers out of the stabilization stage of their customer journey
* Contribute to the development of repeatable professional services offerings and packages
* Deliver data\-driven consulting recommendations based on industry and segment best practices
* Execute on defined professional services engagements
* Identify new Professional Services opportunities with existing customers, engaging with Account Managers to define and pitch those opportunities
* Support Implementation Specialists in learning the product and market, and in delivering quality engagements
* Provide input into the development of new professional services offerings
* Provide ongoing coaching to Implementation Specialists on your projects, including documenting feedback useful to their manager
* Maintain up\-to\-date knowledge of, and compliance with, internal processes and procedures
* Perform other job\-related duties as assigned
* Travel will be required
* Occasional work on the weekend is required

**What You Bring to the Team**
------------------------------


* 4\+ years of experience in software or business process consulting and/or home health care
* 2\+ years of experience leading complex internal/external engagements, including functional and cross\-functional teams
* Exceptional written and verbal communications in both English and French
* A passion for understanding customers' business goals and challenges
* The ability to effectively communicate with customer leadership
* The ability to recognize and articulate complex problems related to a project
* Deep expertise in the AlayaCare platform and/or relevant functional areas
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, including experience successfully delivering presentations and managing meetings
* The ability to handle various projects simultaneously, adapting quickly and easily while managing competing priorities
* A strong willingness to take initiative, work autonomously, and manage time effectively to meet pressing deadlines

**Location and Work Model**
---------------------------



This role is based in the Greater Montreal Area. At AlayaCare, our hybrid model includes set in\-office collaboration days, and it is expected that team members are present in the office on those days to foster connection, innovation, and teamwork.


**Why Join AlayaCare?**
-----------------------


**Work With Purpose** At AlayaCare, you'll help build technology that empowers care providers and improves outcomes for patients and families. Every line of code and every customer interaction contributes to making care more connected, accessible, and human.


**Grow in a High\-Trust Culture** We believe in transparency, feedback, and assuming positive intent. Here, you'll feel safe to share your ideas and career goals, and be supported to achieve them through mentorship, career mobility, and a promote\-from\-within philosophy.


**Balance That Works for You** We value flexibility and well\-being. From "Wellness Fridays" to volunteer time off, to flexible vacation, we make sure you have the space to recharge, contribute to your community, and live your best life.


**Benefits That Matter**


* Equity in a well\-funded, scaling company.
* Comprehensive health benefits, telemedicine, and lifestyle spending accounts.
* Parental leave top\-up and family support programs.

**Inclusive by Design** We celebrate diverse perspectives and foster belonging through our DEIB initiatives. Employee\-led events, summits, and social activities, both in\-person and virtual, create meaningful connections across our global teams.


**Ready to Join Us?**
---------------------



Apply today and be part of a company that makes a real difference in the future of home and community care.

jobs.title: IT Support Technician
jobs.description:
**About WCMRC**

  



Western Canada Marine Response Corporation is a Transport Canada\-certified marine response organization responsible for providing marine spill response services along British Columbia’s coast. Our work is operationally complex, time\-sensitive, and essential to protecting coastal communities, marine environments, and critical infrastructure.

  



We are seeking an experienced and capable IT Support Technician to support the administration, security, maintenance, and ongoing improvement of WCMRC's technology environment. This position requires sound technical judgment, strong problem\-solving skills, and the ability to work effectively in both day\-to\-day operations and emergency response environments.

  


**The Opportunity**

  



This position provides technical support to WCMRC employees and assists with the operation and maintenance of the organization's technology systems. With directions from the Director, Information Technology, the successful candidate will gain hands\-on experience supporting Microsoft 365, infrastructure, networking, and end\-user technologies while developing their technical skills \& knowledge.

  


**What You’ll Do**


* Provide Tier 1\-2 level support to end users and oversee access to applications.
* Provide training to staff on usage of newly implemented systems.
* Respond to technical issues and assist with troubleshooting and resolution of hardware, software, and infrastructure problems.
* Assist with maintenance, monitoring, and support of infrastructure systems under the guidance of senior IT staff.
* Ensure project documentation is complete and archived appropriately following project completion.
* Collaborate with network services, software systems engineering and/or application development to restore service and/or identify problems.
* Assist with the administration and support of Microsoft Active Directory, Microsoft 365, and related infrastructure systems.
* Foster positive communications within the organization, the department, and work teams from a technology standpoint.
* Participate in infrastructure projects (systems and networks).
* Identify and communicate ideas for improving software processes.
* Assist in other duties involving computer and network setup and operations.
* Primarily provide remote support but also provide on\-site support as required.

  


**Our Commitment as a Response Organization**

  



WCMRC is an emergency response organization. Candidates must understand that our work is urgent, operationally dynamic, and often unpredictable. During a response, exercise, incident, or other operational requirement, shifts, schedules, reporting relationships, priorities, and assigned duties may change to meet organizational needs and to align with the Incident Command System structure.

  



This role requires flexibility, resilience, sound judgment, and a clear commitment to operational readiness, safety, accountability, and effective emergency response.

  


**Required Skills and Experience**

  



We are looking for a technically capable IT Support Technician who can work independently while knowing when to collaborate or escalate. The successful candidate will bring:

  


* Diploma, certificate, or equivalent education in Information Technology, Networking, Systems Administration, or a related field.
* Microsoft certification.
* 1\+ years of previous and progressive technical support, IT help desk, or related experience.
* Demonstrated experience providing software application support including dealing with users, and working with computers, printers, and phones.
* Experience supporting Windows workstations, Microsoft 365, printers, mobile devices, or other business technology.
* Demonstrated interest in learning new technologies and developing technical skills.

  


**Why Join WCMRC**

  



We know that meaningful work is only part of the equation. That is why we offer a competitive and comprehensive total rewards package that includes:

  


* Competitive compensation with an incentive plan.
* 100% employer\-paid benefits for you and your family.
* Generous and flexible work arrangements, including options for compressed work weeks.
* Defined Contribution Pension Plan (DCPP) to support your long\-term financial wellness.
* Ongoing training and development opportunities to support personal and career growth.
* The opportunity to work alongside dedicated professionals committed to protecting the West Coast environment.

  




Salary Range: $68,438 to $80,515 annually, based on experience and qualifications. A higher starting salary may be considered for applicants who bring additional relevant experience, advanced expertise, or exceptional qualifications aligned with the needs of the role.

  


**Ready to Apply?**

  



Bring your organizational expertise, initiative, and judgment to a role where you will make a meaningful impact every day. Apply today and help enable the leadership that protects our coast.

  



To apply, please submit your resume and cover letter. Applicants must be legally entitled to work in Canada.

  



We welcome applications from people with diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives If you require accommodation during the recruitment process, please let us know and we will work with you to support your participation.

  



We appreciate all applications; however, only candidates selected to move forward in the recruitment process will be contacted.

jobs.title: Network Support Technician (On-Site) -Information Technologies
jobs.description:
**Description**


The **Information Technologies** is currently seeking a Full\-time Regular **Network Support Technician**.


The Network Services team provides reliable, secure, and scalable network connectivity to the University community. This is a hands\-on, front\-line technical position that reports to the Network Services Manager and works directly with faculty, staff, students, service teams, contractors, and other clients at campus locations.


The position works a seven\-hour day beginning at 7:00 a.m., Monday to Friday. Regular on\-campus attendance is an essential requirement because the work involves physical network equipment, telecommunications spaces, client locations, and in\-person troubleshooting. The position is not eligible for remote or work\-from\-home arrangements. Travel to remote sites is required, and occasional work outside regular hours may be necessary for planned changes, urgent incidents, or operational needs.


The work requires frequent movement between campus locations, competing priorities, timely client communication, and safe work around active network infrastructure. The incumbent may be required to lift and carry equipment, climb ladders, work in telecommunications rooms or other constrained spaces, and distinguish colour\-coded cabling.


The incumbent independently handles routine access\-layer incidents, approved port activations, equipment replacement, physical checks, validation, client communication, and documentation. Changes with broader service impact, unclear ownership, elevated security risk, or implications for core routing, firewall policy, network architecture, or NAC policy design must be escalated and approved through the appropriate operational or change\-management process.

**Summary of Key Responsibilities** (job functions include but are not limited to):


Front\-Line Client and Incident Support


* Receive, assess, prioritize, and resolve wired and wireless network incidents and service requests.
* Continuously and proactively monitor the ServiceNow queue throughout the workday, including before and after field assignments and at appropriate intervals while working away from the office. Promptly identify, acknowledge, prioritize, update, and advance assigned incidents and service requests. Active queue management is a critical responsibility and a key measure of success in this role.
* Work directly with clients to understand symptoms, explain findings in clear language, set realistic expectations, and confirm service restoration.
* Troubleshoot connectivity across the client device, wall outlet, cabling, switch port, wireless access point, VLAN, DHCP/DNS services, authentication, and NAC policy path.
* Use available monitoring, management, ticketing, and diagnostic tools to isolate faults and collect evidence.
* Escalate complex, high\-impact, security\-related, or out\-of\-scope issues with complete troubleshooting notes and relevant logs.
* Coordinate with the service desk, Network Services analysts, identity and security teams, vendors, contractors, and other technical groups until ownership and next actions are clear.
* Work effectively and safely alone at client and technical locations. Exercise sound judgement within established procedures, organize and complete assigned work without continuous supervision, maintain communication while in the field, and promptly escalate safety concerns, service risks, or issues outside the role's authority.


Access\-Layer Installation and Operations

* Install, replace, connect, label, terminate, rework, test, and remove access\-layer equipment and associated infrastructure in accordance with University standards. This includes access switches, wireless access points, UPS units, optics, power supplies, copper and fibre cabling, patch cables, and BIX cross\-connects and termination fields.
* Perform approved routine UPS inspections and maintenance, including UPS battery replacement and complete UPS unit swaps. After completing the work, verify load, alarms, power restoration, and operation of connected network equipment. Escalate electrical faults, capacity concerns, unsafe conditions, or work requiring a qualified electrical trade to the appropriate service owner.
* Activate, deactivate, and validate switch ports; apply approved access\-layer configurations; and confirm VLAN, Power over Ethernet, speed, duplex, authentication, and reachability.
* Support Aruba and Juniper switching and wireless platforms during the transition to Juniper, including approved operational work through the applicable management platforms.
* Adhere to University Networking standards at all times. This is a paramount responsibility and a key measure of success in the role. Perform pre\-change checks, follow approved implementation, change\-management, and rollback procedures, validate service after work is completed, and promptly report unexpected results or deviations from standard
* Assist with network refreshes, moves, additions, changes, equipment inventories, site surveys, and coordinated maintenance activities.
* Work safely in active telecommunications spaces and protect service continuity, equipment, cabling, and client areas.


Network Access Control and Technical Troubleshooting

* Use Aruba ClearPass to investigate authentication, authorization, endpoint profiling, posture assessment, role assignment, and device\-onboarding issues within assigned access.
* Interpret common 802\.1X, MAC authentication, RADIUS, DHCP, DNS, VLAN, spanning\-tree, link, and PoE symptoms to determine the likely fault domain.
* Validate whether a problem is local to a client, port, cable, access switch, access point, building, or shared service before resolving or escalating it.
* Follow security, privacy, change\-management, and privileged\-access requirements. Do not alter firewall policy, core\-routing architecture, or restricted security controls unless specifically authorized and assigned.

jobs.title: Junior IT Infrastructure Technician
jobs.description:
**About Sync**  

Sync is a Canadian company building zero\-knowledge, end\-to\-end encrypted cloud storage and collaboration for over two million people and businesses worldwide. Unlike most of our competitors, we own and operate our own storage infrastructure rather than renting it. Our customers’ data lives on our hardware, in our racks, in Canada. That is a core part of our product promise, and it means the physical infrastructure is not a back\-office concern here. It is the product.  

  

**About the role**  

We are hiring a Junior IT Infrastructure Technician to help maintain the JBODs, servers, and network gear in our Toronto colocation facility. This is a hybrid role based in Toronto, with regular travel to our Toronto Data Centre required to do hands\-on work, and a genuinely strong entry point into storage and infrastructure engineering, you will be working directly on petabyte\-scale storage systems from your first week.  

  

You will rack and maintain hardware, replace failed drives and components, own the RMA process end to end, manage procurement, and support the day\-to\-day IT needs of the team. We are looking for someone early in their career who is curious about how things work and who moves toward problems instead of waiting to be assigned them. You will not be expected to arrive knowing everything. You will be expected to ask good questions, document what you learn, and take real ownership of the things you touch. Once you're ramped up, this role will also include participation in an on\-call rotation.  

  

**What you will do*** Maintain our JBOD storage enclosures: identify and replace failed drives, verify rebuilds complete cleanly, and track drive health and failure trends over time.
* Install, cable, configure, provision and decommission servers and storage chassis in our Toronto colocation cage.
* Diagnose and resolve hardware faults across drives, memory, PSUs, HBAs, SAS expanders, backplanes, and network components.
* Support network infrastructure: rack and cable switches, maintain accurate port maps, and assist with configuration changes under supervision.
* Support the team during critical situations: respond to monitoring alerts, work the relevant runbook, and help recover systems from unexpected failures.
* Own the RMA process end to end: identify the failure, open the case with the vendor, track the shipment, install the replacement, and confirm the fix. Then make sure the inventory reflects reality.
* Manage procurement for hardware and IT equipment, including quoting, purchase orders, receiving, and day\-to\-day vendor communication.
* Maintain an accurate asset inventory covering serial numbers, warranty status, rack and slot locations, and lifecycle state.
* Keep the cage clean and auditable through disciplined structured cabling, labelling, and cable management.
* Handle media sanitization and secure disposal of decommissioned drives in line with our security policies.
* Coordinate with the colocation provider on remote hands, access approvals, power and cooling questions, and scheduled maintenance windows.
* Provide general IT support to internal staff, including laptop provisioning, account setup, and endpoint troubleshooting.
* Write and improve runbooks so the next person can do the task without having to ask.
* Participate in an on\-call rotation for incidents after an onboarding period.

**What we are looking for*** 0 to 2 years of experience in IT support, datacenter operations, or a related hands\-on technical role. Co\-op terms, internships, home labs, and personal projects all count.
* A proactive mindset. You notice the drive that keeps throwing errors before it fails outright, and you raise it.
* Real curiosity about infrastructure. You want to understand why a system behaves the way it does, not just which button restarts it.
* Working knowledge of server and storage hardware, and comfort using hand tools in a rack environment.
* Linux fundamentals at the command line: navigating the filesystem, reading logs with journalctl and dmesg, and using basic disk and filesystem tooling such as lsblk, smartctl and df.
* Basic networking knowledge: IP addressing, VLANs, switching, subnetting, routing and the ability to read and maintain a cable map.
* Care and precision around data. In a live storage environment, pulling the wrong drive matters — we need someone who checks twice before executing any task.
* Clear written communication. A significant part of this job is leaving a good record for the next person.
* Strong organizational habits, particularly around tracking assets, tickets, and open vendor cases.
* Ability to work on\-site in Toronto and to lift and position equipment weighing up to 50 lbs.
* Eligibility to work in Canada.

**Nice to have*** Exposure to a colocation or datacenter environment.
* Familiarity with SAS or SATA storage topologies, RAID or erasure coding concepts, or distributed storage systems such as ZFS or Ceph.
* Scripting in Bash or Python to automate repetitive work such as drive health checks or inventory reconciliation.
* Experience with out\-of\-band management tools such as iDRAC, iLO, or IPMI.
* Any exposure to a switch CLI – Cisco NX\-OS or IOS, HP ProCurve, or similar –even if only show commands.
* Any exposure to monitoring and alerting tooling such as Prometheus, Grafana, Zabbix.
* Familiarity with Containers (Docker, LXC) or with a directory and identity service for user and device management.
* Certifications such as CompTIA A\+, Network\+, Server\+, or equivalent coursework.

**Perks:*** Compensation range: $50,000 to $58,000 CAD
* Generous WSA program
* Best\-in\-the\-class health benefits
* Paid vacation with carry\-over
* Flexible Hybrid
* Direct hands\-on experience with petabyte\-scale storage infrastructure that very few companies our size operate themselves.
* A clear growth path toward storage, systems, or network engineering, with mentorship from the senior staff who built this infrastruct

This position offers an excellent opportunity to gain meaningful work experience while contributing to a welcoming and inclusive library environment that serves communities across Vancouver Island, Haida Gwaii, and Bella Coola.

**What you’ll do**

Under the direction and support of the IT Operations Manager, the Service Desk Analyst is the first point of contact for employees experiencing technical issues with Vancouver Island Regional Library (VIRL) owned technology, hardware and software and IT services. This includes VIRL’s public computing services. The Service Desk Analyst is responsible for providing Service Desk Support and resolving problems to the end user’s satisfaction concerning software, hardware, mobile devices, and network connectivity.

The Service Desk Analyst contributes to the effective operation of the IT Division through support, maintenance, and provisioning (with Manager approval) of the networked hardware and software, including PCs, Laptops, Tablets, Phones, computer applications and other related peripheral equipment.

* Provide excellent customer service to staff throughout VIRL by telephone, email, virtual client web portal or face\-to\-face interaction.

* Manage system incident workflow from identification to closure including communication to end client until the issue is resolved.
* Resolve various service requests including:

* Install additional software and hardware (e.g. printers, scanners, network cards, etc.).
* Utilize system tools for proper imaging and deployment of devices as appropriate (Imaging, Mobile Device Management etc.)
* Maintain user access administration for appropriate services. (e.g. Internet, e\-mail, WAN/LAN/WLAN, FTP access)
* Upgrade or replace existing computer hardware and components. (e.g. hard drive, RAM, monitor, printer, and motherboard)
* Install and/or upgrade end user computer software and operating systems.
* Address end user computing hardware/software deficiencies directly with vendors and identify where warranties are valid. (licenses, certificates etc.)
* Provide system/security access management by setting up and maintaining user and group accounts with various rights for access to applications, files and print services.

**What you bring**

* Completion of a Degree or Diploma in the Information Technology field or equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.
* Minimum 2 years’ of service desk experience.
* Completion of ITIL Foundation, A\+ or Microsoft Certified Professional certification.
* Working knowledge of Office 365 and Azure services.
* Working knowledge to efficiently build, maintain and support complex network, server, and storage environments (physical and virtual).
* Ability to prioritize and manage multiple requests, projects and timeline commitments.
* Demonstrated integrity and ability to maintain confidentiality associated with proprietary organizational, employee and customer data.
* Knowledgeable in the use of tools for mass deployment and maintenance of computers and mobile technologies. (E.g. Group policies, mobile device management, etc.)
* Excellent customer service skills and interpersonal skills to listen and understand a non\-technical users challenge, frustration or request.
* Valid BC driver’s license; may be required to travel and use own vehicle.
* Successful completion of a Criminal Record Check

**Why VIRL**

Vancouver Island Regional Library acknowledges that it operates on the traditional territories of the 53 First Nations within its service area, who are members of the Coast Salish, Haida, Nuu\-chah\-nulth, Kwakwaka’wakw, and Nuxálk peoples. VIRL honours its relationships with these Nations and with all First Nations, Métis, and Inuit peoples who reside in the region.

VIRL is one of the largest regional library systems in Canada, serving both rapidly growing urban centres and some of the most rural and remote communities in the country. Working in partnership with 38 local governments across a 42,000 km² service area, VIRL is committed to supporting livability, affordability, accessibility, literacy, lifelong learning, and community connection throughout the region.

At VIRL, we are committed to building a collaborative, inclusive, and forward\-thinking organizational culture where employees are supported to learn, grow, and make a meaningful impact in the communities they serve.

* Multiple ways to bank\-online, mobile app, phone/full\-service Member Connect Contact Centre, and, of course, in\-branch\-DUCA is accessible 24/7
* A community philosophy of "profits with a purpose" culminating in the creation of the DUCA Impact Lab (www.ducaimpactlab.com), a charitable foundation committed to helping the credit challenged and underbanked. This led to DUCA's designation as a B\-Corp certified organization, the first ever credit union to receive this global recognition.


A career with DUCA means you'll find endless opportunities to make a difference with your unique abilities and perspectives. **Our people live their purpose while helping others Do more, Be more and Achieve more with their money and their lives.** At DUCA, you'll be part of a vibrant and collaborative team where you'll be supported to excel and make an impact, no matter what role you play.

**DUCA is looking for a Technical Support Analyst** **to join our growing team!**

**Job Purpose \& Summary**

The Technical Support Analyst provides helpdesk support to DUCA employees by resolving hardware and software issues remotely and in person, via phone, remote support tools, and DUCA's ticketing system. The incumbent will use their experience and knowledge of Windows and other software to troubleshoot various software and hardware issues.



Demonstrating a customer\-service approach, the Technical Support Analyst pays close attention to details while troubleshooting problems and communicates effectively with employees at all levels of the organization.


**Key Accountabilities \& Duties**

* Provide end\-user facing desktop support for all internal clients
* Record, track, triage, escalate, and update employee IT requests using DUCA's Help Desk ticketing system
* Respond to all users in a timely manner and troubleshoot tickets efficiently and professionally, demonstrating a strong service\-orientation and adherence to corporate IT standards
* Provide remote technical support using remote control tools
* Track and resolve multiple competing priorities while keeping end users updated on the progress of their open requests
* Document issue resolution progress via detailed notes on steps taken in tickets
* Hardware deployment, relocation and configuration
* Onboard and offboard users within DUCA's network
* Administer and audit access to various websites and programs
* Communicate technical challenges and issues in a way that is clearly understood by DUCA employees at all levels; create instructions and other documents in a clear and easy to follow manner
* Assist with IT projects
* Occasional visits to DUCA branch locations to provide technical support or attend to and transport IT related equipment to and from

* Experience using Help Desk software
* Experience in AD, Azure AD, Microsoft Endpoint and M365/O365 administration

jobs.description:
### **About GovPilot:**


GovPilot provides cloud\-based software solutions to local governments, aiming to make our communities better places to live and work. As a mission\-driven company, GovPilot is committed to creating impactful technology that serves the public good.


We are looking for team members who take pride in their work and seek to consistently improve themselves, their skills, and their knowledge. If this sounds like you–and the type of work environment where you’d thrive–we hope you’ll join us!

### **What We Offer:**

* Competitive salary.
* Unlimited PTO for United States, Accrued PTO for Canada.
* Remote Workforce
* Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance for the United States.
* Professional development opportunities and learning budget.
* Home office and IT budget.
* Supportive team environment.
* The chance to work on innovative projects with cutting\-edge technologies.
##### **What This Job Can Offer You**


Complex and meaningful challenges, helping local governments successfully adopt technology that makes their communities healthier and safer.

* Direct, visible impact on customer success. You'll be a key part of turning a signed contract into a government agency that's up and running on Hedgerow.
* A lot of freedom to organize your work and life. We focus on impact and results, not complicated bureaucracy and unnecessarily rigid standards.
* Competitive salary, unlimited PTO, and a set of benefits.
* A supportive work environment where you can grow and challenge yourself to do your best work.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Support the Project Manager in executing the implementation process for new Hedgerow customers, from kickoff through go\-live.
* Analyze and understand each customer's business processes and apply best practices to guide how those processes translate into Hedgerow.
* Become a product expert to configure the platform to match each agency's specific workflows, data, and compliance requirements.
* Strong understanding of SaaS platforms, cloud environments, and data management principles required.
* Proficiency with tools such as Wrike, HubSpot, Salesforce, Jira, or other implementation\-related platforms required..
* Create custom reports using Hedgerow's report writing tool, which often involves complex SQL stored procedures.
* Train customer teams (inspectors, administrators, and staff) on how to use Hedgerow.
* Identify and troubleshoot technical or process issues that arise during setup, escalating to the Project Manager as needed.
* Use AI tools to accelerate documentation, data mapping, and configuration work, and help identify where AI can improve implementation speed and quality.
* Document implementation processes and contribute to internal playbooks to improve future onboarding.

**What You Bring**
------------------

* 5\+ years of experience in implementation or onboarding of SaaS solutions.
* Ability to manage multiple customer implementations simultaneously.
* Comfort working with data, including understanding data structures, interpreting datasets, and validating accuracy across systems.
* Working knowledge of SQL (queries and report writing across relational databases).
* Comfort using AI tools (such as Claude or similar) to speed up data analyses, documentation, and configuration work.
* Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to translate technical concepts for non\-technical government staff.
* Proficiency with tools like HubSpot, or similar CRM/project management platforms.
* A problem\-solving mindset and comfort navigating ambiguity.

**What Makes You Stand Out**
----------------------------

* Experience in Gov\-Tech SaaS, public health, environmental health, or a related sector.
* Experience implementing SaaS solutions for local governments or public health/environmental agencies.
* Hands\-on experience using AI tools to improve workflow efficiency (e.g., data transformation scripts, documentation generation, process automation).
* Self\-motivated, detail\-oriented, and driven to see a project through to a successful launch.

### **Equal Opportunity Employer:**


GovPilot is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. It's important to us that our workforce reflects people of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences and by providing this data, if you choose to, it will help us to stay accountable.

**Join us in creating amazing technology solutions that make a difference. Apply today!**

jobs.description:
**We're transforming the grocery industry**



At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.



Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.


**Instacart is a Flex First team**

There’s no one\-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in\-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

### **This is a remote role that may be performed from any U.S. State except California, Connecticut, New Jersey, New York, and Washington.**


**Why this role is on the menu**
--------------------------------



The Billing Operations Associate owns the end\-to\-end billing lifecycle across Instacart's retail partner portfolio, ensuring accurate invoicing, timely month\-end close, and compliance with financial controls.

  



The ideal candidate thrives in a fast\-paced operational environment, takes ownership of their work, and is committed to delivering high\-quality, accurate results consistently.

  


**What you'll cook up in your first year**
------------------------------------------


* Monthly billing cycles are executed accurately and on time, with invoices calculated, generated, and delivered via email and third\-party portals such as Ariba.
* Credit memos, debit memos, and refunds are processed in accordance with approved requests.
* Oracle workbooks are built and maintained for new and amended contracts.
* Commercial contracts are reviewed to identify billing requirements, with billing language validated with senior team members as needed.
* Peer reviews of invoice calculations are completed to ensure accuracy and adherence to contract terms.
* Billing inquiries are responded to promptly, with complex disputes escalated appropriately.
* Audit requests are supported and ad hoc projects are completed accurately and on time.
* Established SOPs and internal controls are followed to ensure consistent and compliant billing operations.

  


**The secret ingredients we're looking for**
--------------------------------------------


**Must\-have pantry staples (Minimum Qualifications)**


* 2\+ years of experience in billing operations, accounts receivable, order\-to\-cash, or a similar role, preferably in a a B2B tech, marketplace, or SaaS environment
* Foundational understanding of invoicing processes, ERP workflows, and AR fundamentals
* Strong attention to detail with the ability to manage high\-volume workloads accurately
* Expert proficiency with spreadsheets (Google Sheets, Microsoft Excel)
* Familiarity with Oracle or similar ERP systems
* Familiarity with Salesforce or similar CRM
* Clear and professional communication skills with the ability to work cross\-functionally
* Ability to follow defined processes and controls while knowing when to escalate
* Self\-starter who takes ownership and delivers on commitments

  


**Optional garnishes (Preferred Qualifications)**


* Experience with BI or data tools such as Alteryx or SQL
* Experience or aptitude to leverage AI tooling to augment or automate processes
* Familiarity with marketplace, subscription, or advertising billing models
* Exposure to working with Finance, Legal, or Sales teams in a cross\-functional capacity


\#LI\-Remote


Instacart provides highly market\-competitive compensation and benefits in each location where our employees work. This role is remote and the base pay range for a successful candidate is dependent on their permanent work location. Please review our Flex First remote work policy here. Currently, we are only hiring in the following provinces: Ontario, Alberta, British Columbia and Nova Scotia.



Offers may vary based on many factors, such as candidate experience and skills required for the role. Please read more about our benefits offerings here.



For Canadian based candidates, the base pay ranges for a successful candidate are listed below.


CAN

**Turn your engineering degree into a career that makes a real impact.**

* Project Management


* Supply Chain


* And possibly others!

Some example rotations include Field Operations, Technical Services, Manufacturing, Technology and Commercial.

Orica accepts graduates from a range of engineering disciplines including:


* Mining Engineering


* Chemical Engineering


* Geology or Geological Engineering


* Other Engineering degrees, as appropriate

* Be eligible to work in Canada with no sponsorship
* Be eligible to drive a motor vehicle in Canada
* Be in your final year of your university undergraduate degree or have completed your degree within the last year
* Be willing to undergo a pre\-employment background check, medical and drug screen

You will be paid a competitive salary, learn from talented individuals across multiple disciplines and be able to thrive in a safe workplace within a collaborative culture. Ignite your career at a place where your distinct potential can find its home.

Build Access. Build Solutions. Build Your Career.
  
At Northern Mat \& Bridge, we deliver innovative access solutions that support infrastructure, energy, and industrial projects across Canada. Our success is built on the strength of our people, from the field to the office, working together with integrity, safety, and pride. * Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team environment.

jobs.title: Data Engineer - Onboarding
jobs.description:
**Who we are:**


Sardine is the leading agentic risk platform for fighting financial crime. Our integrated solution unifies data across risk teams to help organizations stop fraud in real time, prevent AI\-driven attacks, and automate fraud and AML operations. Sardine’s platform is strengthened by one of the fastest\-growing fraud consortiums in the market, spanning more than 6 billion profiled devices, 800 million consumers, and 3 million businesses worldwide. Leading companies including FIS, GoDaddy, Intuit, Edward Jones, ZoomInfo, and Checkout.com rely on Sardine to secure and grow trust in their products.

**Our culture:**

* We hire talented, self\-motivated individuals with extreme ownership and high growth orientation.
* We value performance and not hours worked. We believe you shouldn't have to miss your family dinner, your kid's school play, friends get\-together, or doctor's appointments for the sake of adhering to an arbitrary work schedule.
* We're a remote\-first team spread across time zones, so no office to report to \- work from wherever helps you do your best work. Just a couple of things to keep in mind: pay is based on where you're located, and you'll need to keep a home base in the country you're hired in. So while we love the "coffee shop today, mountains tomorrow" life, this isn't a passport\-optional, work\-from\-anywhere\-on\-Earth kind of remote \- think flexible *within* your country, not borderless.

**Location:**

* Remote \- United States or Canada

**About the role**


We are looking for a Senior Data/ML Engineer to own the data and machine learning foundation that Sardine's compliance decisions run on. Every onboarding decision we make — a payment approved, an account blocked, a KYC case escalated — is the output of a pipeline someone built. This role owns those pipelines end to end: how data arrives, how it becomes a feature, how that feature becomes a model, and how that model stays correct in production.


This is a high\-impact, highly technical IC role sitting at the intersection of data engineering and ML engineering. We need someone at the senior level to set technical direction for the next order of magnitude: new feature generation, build specific models around KYC onboarding, in house entity matcher for the sanctions and more


You will write production code, make architectural calls that outlive your tenure, and raise the bar for how a small team ships fraud ML. You will work directly with data scientists, backend engineers, and the fraud analysts who use what you build.

**What you'll be doing**

* Own the data ingestion layer that brings device telemetry, transaction events, KYC/identity signals, and third\-party enrichment into the platform — designing streaming pipelines (Pub/Sub, Apache Beam on Dataflow, Flink) and batch pipelines (Python, Airflow on Cloud Composer, Spark on Dataproc) that are correct, observable, and cheap to extend.
* Build and evolve our feature platform, where the same Chronon feature definitions are computed by Flink for streaming and Spark for batch, with aggregation windows from one hour to 300 days, served to the rules engine and to models under a sub\-second budget.
* Establish feature correctness as an engineering discipline: streaming\-versus\-batch reconciliation, recomputation tests against the warehouse, train/serve parity checks, and drift monitoring that catches a broken feature before an analyst does.
* Productionize fraud and identity ML models — training pipelines on Vertex AI and Kubeflow, gradient\-boosted and tree\-based models (XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost, scikit\-learn), hyperparameter search, SHAP\-based explanations, and score normalization — and build the automated retraining, champion/challenger promotion, and rollback machinery we don't yet have.
* Engineer KYC, AML, and identity risk signals: document verification and doc\-KYC outcomes, sanctions/PEP/adverse\-media screening results, email and phone risk, synthetic identity indicators, bank and account verification, and periodic customer due diligence — turning noisy, multi\-vendor, multi\-jurisdiction data into features a model can actually learn from.
* Integrate and harden new data sources, including 30\+ third\-party enrichment providers called in parallel on the request path, plus our cross\-client consortium network — owning failover behavior, timeout budgets, graceful degradation, caching, and cost.
* Own the warehouse and modeling layer in BigQuery — partitioning strategy, the staging\-to\-mart layer cake, training datasets, and the in\-flight migration off dbt onto scheduled SQL and Python pipelines.
* Design the entity resolution and graph data that link customers, devices, emails, phones, cards, bank accounts, and crypto addresses across clients, including large\-scale connected\-components work.
* Make the platform safe by construction: field\-level encryption for sensitive identifiers, regional data residency enforced in the pipeline definitions, PII handling and deletion paths, and feature\-level gating so a bad signal can be turned off without a deploy.
* Set technical direction and raise the team's ceiling — write the design docs, run the reviews, mentor engineers and data scientists, and decide what we build versus buy.

**What you'll need**

* 8\+ years building production data and ML systems, with real ownership of both the pipeline side and the model side. You have shipped models that made consequential automated decisions, not just dashboards.
* Deep Python and strong SQL. You are fluent in a distributed processing framework (Spark, Beam, or Flink) and comfortable reasoning about streaming semantics — windowing, watermarks, late data, exactly\-once versus at\-least\-once, and where correctness actually breaks.
* Hands\-on experience with a modern cloud data stack: GCP strongly preferred (BigQuery, Dataflow, Dataproc, Pub/Sub, Bigtable, Composer, Vertex AI) or the AWS equivalents, plus Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, and CI/C

jobs.title: Data Migration Specialist
jobs.description:
Data Migration Specialist


**Location**: ST. JOHN'S, Newfoundland and Labrador or Remote



ClearRisk empowers our customers by optimizing risk and improving safety for their employees and the general public. We keep people from harm and help our customers be more successful. Our cloud\-based claims and risk management solutions provide customers with a suite of tools and insights built for industries such as municipalities, utilities, real estate/property groups, manufacturers, retailers and more. Our solutions lower insurance and risk management costs while giving meaningful data insights that drive business growth.


**About the Role**



ClearRisk's implementation work involves moving customer data – often complex, agency\- or municipality\-specific data – into our platform's data model. This role exists to own the accuracy and integrity of that process: defining how source data maps to our data model, verifying that mappings and transformations are correct, and executing migrations directly using our ETL tooling.



This is not strictly a software development role, nor is it a traditional test/QA role. It is a role for someone who is obsessed with getting data right, and who wants to understand *why* a field maps where it does, *why* a transformation is needed, and *what* value it provides for the customer – not just confirm that a process ran without error.


**What You'll Do**


* Participate in requirements gathering and define source\-to\-target data mapping specifications for customer integration and migration projects, in partnership with the Business Analyst and other Implementation team members
* Own quality verification of data mappings and transformations – both pre\-load and post\-load – ensuring data lands correctly, cleanly, and in a way that reflects the customer's actual business need
* Execute standard migrations/integrations directly using ClearRisk's internal ETL tooling (Excel\-competency level of complexity)
* Partner with developers on complex, custom\-coded integration builds, validating that implemented mappings match the intended specification and that output data is correct (a QA/validation role on these projects, not a build role)
* Document mapping decisions and transformation logic clearly enough that intent ("why this maps here") is understood by others, not just the mechanics
* Flag data quality issues, mapping ambiguities, or edge cases for resolution


**What You'll Bring**


* Strong Excel/spreadsheet fluency; comfort with ETL\-style tooling
* Demonstrated obsession with data accuracy/quality, ideally with examples of catching subtle data issues and not just obvious ones
* Ability to understand and question business context – why a piece of data matters, not just where it goes
* Comfortable working closely with developers without being one. Can read a data model, ask good questions, and evaluate output without writing code
* Data\-focused coding experience (Python, SQL, etc.) would be an advantage
* Experience with AI\-assisted tooling (e.g. using LLMs to safely assist with mapping suggestions, data review, or documentation) would be beneficial
* Experience with handling sensitive data in regulated environments (e.g. PII/PHI, healthcare, financial services, government) would be a bonus, as the data this role touches can be sensitive in nature
* Familiarity with insurance and risk management would be a plus


We are looking for a driven individual who is motivated to build their career. This is a full\-time permanent position with a competitive salary, benefits package and more.



ClearRisk may use AI\-enabled tools to support parts of the recruitment process, including reviewing and assessing applications. Human team members are involved throughout the hiring process, and all decisions about candidate progression and selection are made by people. If you have any questions or require accommodation, please contact the hiring contact at ddunne@clearrisk.com

Are you a software developer who wants your technical work to matter for something bigger? The global energy transition is reshaping Canada’s economy, and the decisions being made right now will determine whether the country comes out stronger or falls behind. **About the Transition Accelerator**
------------------------------------


The Transition Accelerator is helping Canada win in the global energy transition — economically and geopolitically. We are harnessing the global shift towards clean growth to secure permanent jobs, abundant energy, and strong regional economies across the country. We work with 300\+ partner organizations to build out pathways to a prosperous low\-carbon economy and avoid costly dead\-ends along the way. By connecting systems\-level thinking and analysis with real\-world validation, we are enabling a more affordable, competitive, and resilient future for all Canadians.


Work at the Transition Accelerator is collaborative and fast\-moving. Priorities evolve as new questions and evidence emerge, and teams are expected to iterate, learn, and adjust. You will work independently on challenging problems while coordinating closely with colleagues and partners. Successful team members are solution\-oriented, proposing practical options and paths forward while working collaboratively to address challenges, not just identify them.

**About the Role**
------------------


You will be the first dedicated software engineer on the I\&A team, establishing the engineering practice and infrastructure that turns the organization's analytical work into lasting, usable products. The goal is to make those capabilities faster, deeper, and more accessible — both for internal teams and for the wider analytical community, as we increasingly move to open\-source our tools. You will translate complex analytical concepts into working software that people can use to test assumptions, compare scenarios, and make better decisions about Canada's energy future.

* Demonstrated ability to develop and deploy web applications, including front\-end interfaces and back\-end services.

jobs.description:
**The Team**
------------


IC Group builds powerful digital engagement solutions that connect brands with people through promotions, live events, mobile messaging, and gamified experiences. We work with leading brands and event operators to create experiences that drive participation, loyalty, and measurable results.


Our teams are responsible for the secure delivery and execution of all client programs and projects. ICG aims to act as a trusted partner and strives to deepen client relationships based on trust, security, integrity, commitment, accountability, and delivery. We are continuously evolving our solutions and are further modernizing our IT practices through various initiatives, inclusive of AI use in strategic ways, and adopting a platform foundation.


**Role Overview**
-----------------


The **IT Systems \& Support Specialist** is a hands\-on role with two equally important responsibilities. The first is support of our cloud and on\-premise productivity platforms: administering Microsoft Azure, Windows Servers and Microsoft 365 day to day, keeping them secure, well documented, and cost\-aware. The second is direct support of our people: this is the person our staff reach for when a laptop, an account, a printer, or an application gets in the way of their work.


This position sits between the IT Specialist and the Infrastructure Platform Lead balancing responsibilities from both. It carries more depth than the IT Specialist role in Azure and Microsoft 365, where this person is expected to configure and secure the environment rather than just operate within it. It does not carry accountability for production platform architecture, deployment patterns, or technical leadership of the wider team; those remain with the Infrastructure Platform Lead, who this role partners with closely and escalates to.


Each day will be different, with time split between scheduled cloud and on\-premise platform work, user support and service requests, and progress on corporate projects. Success in the role depends on being genuinely good at all aspects and disciplined about protecting time for the support queue when the platform work is busy.


Given the nature of ICG’s business, this position plays a key role in ensuring the organization meets the expectations of our enterprise clients, including strict compliance with our security standards (such as, but not limited to, **ISO 27001, GDPR, and PCI DSS**) and client\-specific security requirements

* Deploy and manage cloud resources using infrastructure as code rather than portal clicks, maintaining templates with Bicep so environments are repeatable, reviewable, and consistent.
* Maintain and build deployment pipelines in Azure DevOps and GitHub, including source control of infrastructure code, branching and pull request review, and automated build and release pipelines.

* Monitor cloud infrastructure for availability, performance, and capacity, responding to alerts and participating in on\-call duties.
* Track and report cloud spending, flag anomalies, and recommend cost containment opportunities such as rightsizing, and decommissioning unused resources.
* Maintain backup, restore, and recovery processes for cloud workloads, including scheduled restore testing to prove the backups work.
* Keep configuration and procedure documentation current for every environment this role touches, so the environment can be audited and handed over without existing knowledge.

### **Microsoft 365 Administration**


* Administer the Microsoft 365 tenant day to day, including Entra ID, Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, Teams, and Intune.
* Manage identity and access administration: account lifecycle from setup to deletion, group and role assignment, conditional access, and multi\-factor authentication enrolment.
* Administer SharePoint Online and Teams structure, permissions, external sharing, and retention settings in line with our security and licensing standards.
* Maintain Microsoft 365 license assignment and reconciliation so the company is always compliant and is not paying for licenses it does not use.
* Automate recurring administrative work with PowerShell and Microsoft 365 native tooling, and document what the scripts do.

### **Server and Application Support**


* Maintain and administer Windows servers and the corporate applications running on them, ensuring a high level of security, performance, and uptime.

* Monitor servers and services for issues with applications, disk space, CPU, memory, or anything else that may affect end users, and act as a first responder during on\-call duties.
* Support deployment and configuration of corporate and custom applications, escalating production platform changes to the Infrastructure Platform Lead.

### **On\-Premise Infrastructure Support**

**About The Role – Fly In, Fly Out \- Field Technician (Fort St. John, BC)**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------

  

  

We are excited to announce a new opportunity for a Field Technician in Fort St. John, BC within our Digital Solutions team. You'll play a crucial role in monitoring a new dam structure by maintaining, troubleshooting, and collecting data from geotechnical instruments. Gain valuable hands\-on experience in a dynamic field environment! We are seeking technical candidates with proven instrumentation experience.  



**WORK SCHEDULE**: This is a fly\-in/fly\-out position on a rotation schedule 15 days on shift with12 hour days (fly in /fly out) / 6 days off. This work schedule may change in the coming months to 15 days on/ 15 days off.

  

**LOGISTICS**: Travel provided from British Columbia and Alberta. Travel and accommodations are provided.

  

Please Note: This posting is intended to collect candidate information for Orica’s talent pool and does not represent an immediate job opening. By completing your candidate profile, our recruiters will gain visibility into your background and may contact you for future opportunities that align with your experience and interests. To stay informed about new openings, we also encourage you to create a Job Alert on our career site. This feature allows you to set your preferred job criteria and receive email notifications when matching positions are posted.


**What you will be doing**
--------------------------

  

* Collect manual and automated instrumentation readings, conduct data checks, reductions, and analysis.
* Assist with the installation, testing, calibration, commissioning, repair and maintenance of geotechnical instruments and the permanent automated data acquisition system (ADAS) including the MIMS.
* Maintain, calibrate and use all equipment related to the above tasks.

* Excellent communication skills.
* Organized, detail\-oriented, strong work ethic, problem\-solver.
* Valid Class 5 driver's license with a clean record.
* Willing to work in a remote location on a rotational basis.
* Able to work outdoors for extended periods in extreme weather.


**Role dimensions**
-------------------

  

* All employees working at Site\-C must adhere to the drug and alcohol policy and successfully pass drug \& alcohol testing prior to employment.

jobs.title: Support Analyst - Red Lake ON
jobs.description:
**About FSET Inc**  
FSET Inc is an ISO 27001:2022 certified Managed Services Provider headquartered in Kenora, serving law enforcement, healthcare, municipal and First Nations clients across Canada since 1999\. Our work includes the patented ConnectedOfficer Program, cybersecurity services and cloud infrastructure, delivered by a team of more than 30 people, all based in Canada.  


**Position Overview**  
We are hiring a Support Analyst to live and work in Red Lake, Ontario. This is a permanent, full\-time, home\-based position. You work from home and go onsite to FSET clients in Red Lake and neighbouring communities, including Pikangikum First Nation, where we support a number of community organizations.  


You are often the only FSET person on site, which makes network troubleshooting central to the job. When a site loses connectivity, you work the fault from the cable to the carrier: confirm the link, check addressing, DNS and the gateway, test at the internet connection, and establish whether the problem sits on the client's network or with the provider. If it is the provider's, you open the carrier ticket, supply the evidence and see it through. You own the fault until it is resolved or handed on with a complete diagnosis.  


Given who our clients are, you will work to a high standard of security and documentation, and we train and support you to meet it.  


**Work Environment and Location Requirements**  
You work from a home office in Red Lake with a private workspace and a reliable internet connection. Road travel to clients around Red Lake is a regular part of the week. Pikangikum is reached by air year\-round, by winter road from January to March and by boat in the warmer months, and some visits include an overnight stay. A valid driver's licence and reliable transportation are essential.  


**Key Responsibilities**  


* Take client requests by phone, email, portal and onsite; triage, diagnose, and resolve or escalate within service levels
* Troubleshoot network faults end to end: cabling and switch ports, Wi\-Fi, DHCP, DNS, VLANs, VPN clients and the internet connection, and manage carrier tickets with test evidence through to resolution
* Administer Microsoft 365 for managed clients: user lifecycle, licensing, Exchange Online, Entra ID and Intune
* Deploy and support Windows devices with Autopilot and Intune, along with mobile devices, printers, VoIP handsets and network equipment
* Keep documentation current for every ticket, client and site you work on
* Follow FSET information security policies and procedures without exception

**Required Qualifications**  


* 2\+ years of IT support at an MSP or in a multi\-client environment, including hands\-on administration of Microsoft 365, Entra ID and Intune
* Hands\-on TCP/IP troubleshooting: you read ipconfig, ping, tracert and nslookup output with ease, understand DHCP, DNS, subnetting, NAT and VLANs, and can isolate a fault to the local network or the internet provider
* Live in or relocate to Red Lake, hold a valid full driver's licence, and travel regionally by road, air and water
* Fluent professional English, written and verbal, a clear criminal record check, and eligibility for the security screening our law enforcement clients require

**Preferred Qualifications (Assets)**  


* Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate (MD\-102\) or Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate (SC\-300\)
* CompTIA Network\+ or Security\+, or ITIL Foundation
* Experience supporting business VoIP or UCaaS
* Experience supporting government or other regulated sectors
* Experience working with First Nations communities and organizations
* RMM or PSA platform migration experience
* French

**Professional Attributes**  


* You explain technical problems in plain language to people who are not technical
* You work reliably on your own, with sound judgement about when to bring in help
* You are organized, punctual, and careful with detail and documentation
* You respect each community's protocols and ways of working
* You can kneel, bend and work in tight or restricted spaces

**Compensation and Benefits Package**  


* Health, dental, extended health and vision coverage
* Life and disability insurance
* Employee Assistance Program for mental health and wellness
* RRSP matching
* Paid vacation, personal days and sick leave
* Paid training, plus industry certification support and reimbursement

**Why Join FSET**  


* Great Place to Work Certified every year since 2022, most recently in April 2026, and ranked 22nd on the 2025 Best Workplaces in Canada list for organizations with fewer than 100 employees
* Work that matters to the communities you live and travel in
* A clear promotion path from Support Analyst to Senior Support Analyst
* Colleagues who back you up when you are the only one on site

**Applying to FSET**  
This posting is for an existing vacancy.  


We use an applicant tracking system that screens and scores applications automatically, including with artificial intelligence, based on your answers to the questions on the application form.  


Accommodation is available on request for applicants with disabilities at every stage of our recruitment and selection process.  


Job Types: Full\-time, Permanent  


Pay: $70,200\.00\-$75,400\.00 per year  


Benefits:  


* Dental care
* Disability insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Extended health care
* Life insurance
* Mileage reimbursement
* Paid time off
* RRSP match
* Vision care

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Red Lake, ON

jobs.description:
### **The Opportunity**


Join Dentalcorp as a **Bilingual IT Support Specialist** and play a key role in keeping our corporate Support Centre and national network of dental practices connected, supported, and running smoothly. In this highly visible role, you will use your **English** and **French** communication skills to solve meaningful technical challenges, support modern workplace technologies, and deliver a standout service experience for team members across the business while growing your expertise in a fast\-paced, people\-focused organization.

### **Who You Are**


You are a bilingual, service\-driven IT professional who thrives on solving problems, building trust, and making technology feel seamless for the people you support. With strong troubleshooting skills, clear **English** and **French** communication, and a customer\-first mindset, you take ownership from first contact through resolution while staying organized across competing priorities. You bring professionalism, discretion, and urgency when supporting senior leaders, and you enjoy collaborating with teams, vendors, and managed service providers to deliver secure, reliable, and exceptional technology experiences across a fast\-moving, multi\-site environment.

### **In This Role, You Will**

* Be a trusted first point of support for corporate users and dental practice teams, delivering responsive deskside, remote, and service desk assistance, including white\-glove support for senior leaders.
* Solve a wide range of everyday technology challenges across Microsoft 365, Windows devices, VoIP, telecommunications, mobile devices, printers, conference room technology, business\-critical applications, connectivity, VPN, wireless, and peripherals.
* Support the full device lifecycle by staging, imaging, deploying, maintaining, and troubleshooting hardware that keeps teams productive.
* Own incidents and service requests from intake through resolution by prioritizing, documenting, escalating, monitoring progress, meeting service levels, and keeping stakeholders informed.
* Help team members stay securely connected by supporting user accounts, password resets, access requests, provisioning, SSO, MFA, and identity and access activities across Entra ID, Active Directory, and related platforms.
* Partner closely with vendors, managed service providers, local IT providers, dental practice teams, and internal technical teams to deliver seamless support.
* Spot patterns, support root cause analysis, and contribute ideas that strengthen service quality and the overall user experience.
* Create and maintain practical technical documentation, knowledge articles, SOPs, and end\-user support materials that make support more consistent and efficient.
* Champion reliable, secure support by following IT standards, security policies, access controls, change management practices, and operational procedures.
* Contribute to technology deployments, acquisitions, office initiatives, and operational projects that support Dentalcorp’s continued growth.

### **What You’ll Bring**

* 5\+ years of corporate deskside and service desk support experience in a medium to large enterprise environment, including white\-glove support for senior executives and leadership teams, is required.
* Bilingual written and verbal communication skills in English and French, with a customer\-first mindset and commitment to exceptional service, are required.
* Strong hands\-on experience supporting Windows 10/11, Microsoft 365, Teams, Outlook, enterprise applications, hardware, peripherals, mobile devices, printers, and conference room technologies is required.
* Proficiency with Entra ID, Active Directory, IAM, user provisioning, access administration, SSO, MFA, password management, and access\-related troubleshooting is required.
* Experience with device lifecycle management, ITIL\-based support processes, IT security standards, access controls, change management, technical documentation, and end\-user support materials is required.
* Strong troubleshooting skills across network connectivity, VPNs, wireless networks, VoIP systems, Meraki, and FortiGate environments, with sound judgment to resolve issues independently and escalate when needed.
* Ability to stay organized, prioritize competing demands, support high\-priority executive issues, and coordinate effectively with vendors, managed service providers, local IT providers, and internal technical teams.
* Experience supporting healthcare, dental, or multi\-site environments and certifications such as Microsoft, CompTIA A\+, Network\+, Security\+, or ITIL are considered assets.

 **Why Dentalcorp?**


Dentalcorp is North America’s leading and fastest\-growing network of dental practices. Through industry\-leading technology, expertise, and scale, we help practices grow while supporting dental professionals to retain their clinical autonomy. Here, you’ll be trusted with meaningful responsibility, supported to grow, and surrounded by people who share ideas and raise the bar together. Our **Beyond Brilliant** values—**Beyond the Status Quo**, **Beyond Excellence**, **Brilliant Together**, and **Brilliant Experiences**—guide how we innovate, collaborate, deliver, and put people at the centre.  



  

The salary range for this position is $65,000 CAD to $85,000 CAD annually (plus a bonus of up to 10% and competitive total rewards and benefits package). Offers within this range are determined based on relevant experience, skills, and qualifications, as well as internal equity considerations. This job posting is for an existing vacancy.  



  

You will be based at our **Toronto Support Centre**, located at **181 Bay Street** in the heart of Toronto’s financial district. This position will be on site from Monday to Thursday, with Fridays designated as work\-from\-home days.
