**Job Description:**

**Job Title:** Data Engineer


**Location:** Remote \| Canada


**Reports to:** Sr. Manager \- Data Engineering \& Data Science


**Employment Type:** Full\-time


This is an existing vacancy
  

  

**About the Role:**

  

JD Power is looking for a data engineer with excellent quantitative and analytical skills to help make our data AI\-ready. Our ideal candidates are determined to use their skills to combine multiple data sources together, and to add clear business meaning on top of them, so that both people and AI applications can answer complex client questions around vehicle transactions, incentives, valuations, market readiness, and customer purchase decisions. You’ll work hands on with data on Snowflake to build semantic views, governed metrics, and context layers that power AI assistants and agents, and to improve and maintain existing capabilities.  



We make data products that solve problems for the auto industry. Every data engineer will work on projects that go into production and directly impact new and existing products. In this role, your work decides whether our AI products give accurate, traceable answers instead of guesses.


Grow as a data engineer as part of a medium sized team, where data engineering and AI engineering meet. You will build data pipelines, semantic views, and context layers on Snowflake, deploy them in the cloud, and build monitoring \& QA suites, including tests for AI answer quality.


The team is an experienced set of creative thinkers who are uncovering new and emerging consumer dynamics in an industry starting to go through rapid disruption. We are moving our key data to Snowflake and making it AI\-ready, so our AI assistants and agents can give clients accurate, trusted answers.


We want data engineer candidates who can monitor, improve, and create data processes independently and with an eye toward continuous improvement. We need the capability to leverage the right data sets efficiently from an impressive set of data assets that is unrivaled in this space. We also want someone who is curious about AI, and who knows that AI is only as good as the data and business context behind it.  



**In this role, you will:**

* Daily immersion in automotive industry data
* Build and maintain the business context that makes data AI\-ready: business terms, glossaries, metric definitions, rules, and hierarchies for a data domain (e.g., incentives, pricing, sales, dealers), reviewed and approved by business owners
* Design, build, validate, and publish governed Snowflake semantic views and a versioned metric registry, so every application and AI agent uses one approved definition of each metric
* Help build canonical “master” data sets where multiple sources of truth exist today (e.g., master vehicle/VIN, master dealer, master incentives)
* Prepare unstructured content (PDF documents, glossaries, FAQs, data dictionaries) for retrieval with Snowflake Cortex Search, with metadata and source traceability
* Partner with AI engineers to connect semantic views, metrics, and search services to Cortex Analyst and Cortex Agents
* Design, troubleshoot, and execute repeatable data pipelines on Snowflake (and on our current Google Cloud/BigQuery platform during the transition), in which you’re finding bottlenecks and ways to become incrementally more efficient. You own the reliability of these pipelines and the quality of the data they produce
* Collaborate with stakeholders to gather and understand data processing requirements, with consistent proactive demonstration of business acumen and market dynamics
* Contribute meaningfully to new product development, on top of production, by executing independently to plans (and by influencing the plans themselves) for new features on existing products, and for net\-new products or approaches
* Lead end\-to\-end data engineering projects, and mentor and guide junior data engineers
Interdisciplinary work: you’ll interact with multiple teams across the firm to implement solutions and improve processes. This includes Customer Success, Product Management, Product Development, Technology/Architecture, Data Engineering, Data Science, AI Engineering, Data Visualization, etc.  
* 

  

**Required Qualifications:**

* Must have: strong, hands\-on proficiency in both Python and SQL. You use both every day to build, test, and debug production data pipelines
* Must have: proven production experience in designing, building, and running ETL/ELT pipelines that bring together data from multiple sources, with ownership of their robustness and output data quality (e.g., idempotent jobs, monitoring and alerting, automated data quality checks)
* Software engineering background or experience is a plus: Git and code review, automated testing, CI/CD, and modular, reusable code
* Hands\-on experience with Snowflake is strongly preferred (e.g., Snowpark, Dynamic Tables, role\-based access control), and semantic views or Cortex experience is a big plus. Experience with other cloud platforms such as Google Cloud (BigQuery), AWS, or Palantir is also valued
* Experience building semantic layers or governed metrics (e.g., Snowflake semantic views, dbt Semantic Layer, LookML, AtScale, Cube), with a strong base in dimensional modeling (facts, dimensions, grain)
* Working knowledge of how AI applications use data: retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings and vector search, context and prompt design, tool calling, AI agents, and MCP. Hands\-on experience building an LLM application is a plus
* Familiarity with ontologies, knowledge graphs, data catalogs, metadata management, and data governance (e.g., access control, PII handling, lineage)
* Familiar with AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot), with hands\-on experience using them in daily development work. You know their limits, and you review and test the code they produce before it goes to production

* **Industrialisation des flux** – Participer à la mise en place de flux de données et de processus plus fiables : imports, synchronisations, contrôles, gestion des doublons, suivi des erreurs et réduction des manipulations manuelles.
* **Analyse & benchmarking** – Réaliser des analyses ad hoc : benchmarks salariaux, analyses de coûts, comparaisons marché/internes, suivi de ramp-up, analyses de conversion et identification de tendances ou de points de blocage.
* **Amélioration continue** – Identifier les leviers d’amélioration de la qualité des données et des processus RH et proposer des solutions pragmatiques et adaptées aux besoins opérationnels.
* **Documentation & communication** – Produire une documentation claire et maintenable (définitions de KPI, mapping de données, logique DAX, procédures et workflows) et vulgariser les résultats auprès d’interlocuteurs techniques et non techniques.

  
  

### **Profil**

* **1 à 3 années d’expérience professionnelle** en Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Data Science ou dans un rôle similaire.
* Diplôme universitaire en **génie, informatique, data science, statistique, mathématiques, intelligence d’affaires** ou domaine connexe.
* Bonne maîtrise de **Power BI**, avec une expérience pratique de **Power Query, de la modélisation de données et de DAX**.
* Bonne maîtrise de **SQL** et d’**Excel avancé**.
* Expérience dans la manipulation, le nettoyage et l’analyse de données provenant de **sources multiples et hétérogènes**.
* Capacité à développer des **dashboards, KPI et rapports** permettant de transformer les données en informations utiles à la prise de décision.
* Une expérience avec des outils d’**automatisation** tels que Power Automate, Google Apps Script ou équivalent constitue un atout.
* Rigueur, autonomie, esprit analytique et capacité à résoudre des problèmes.
* Capacité à communiquer clairement les résultats d’analyses auprès d’interlocuteurs techniques et non techniques.
* Intérêt pour les **systèmes RH, People Analytics** et l’utilisation de la donnée pour améliorer le pilotage opérationnel.
* Intérêt marqué pour l’**IA générative** et ses applications concrètes en entreprise.

**Description**

As a Software Developer, you will develop real-time simulation software used in military aircraft system integration laboratories. These engineering simulators reproduce aircraft systems and functions so that teams can test and validate software before it is installed on an aircraft. The emphasis is on aircraft controls and system behaviour rather than visual simulation.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Develop object-oriented software components, primarily in C++, to reproduce aircraft behaviour in real time.

Valid driver’s license, or ability to commute to the Mirabel offices

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience developing real-time simulation software.

Demonstrated interest in aviation.

* Career development and internal mobility opportunities within CAE.

* Comprehensive CAE benefits program, including health insurance, an employee stock purchase plan, a pension plan, and a physical activity program.

* Exposure to automated testing concepts and tools such as Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, WebdriverIO, or similar frameworks.

* Exposure to cloud technologies, CI/CD concepts, and modern software delivery practices.
* Awareness of GenAI tools and technologies and an interest in applying them to software development, testing, productivity, and automation activities.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, troubleshooting, and debugging skills.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment.
* Demonstrated curiosity, willingness to learn, and passion for technology and innovation.
* Ability to adapt quickly in a fast-paced, client-focused, and Agile delivery environment.
* Bachelor’s degree or completion of a college program in a related discipline
* Must be eligible to obtain and maintain Reliability Clearance.
* English is required for this position as this role will regularly interact with English-speaking stakeholders across Canada. Due to the significant high volume of interactions with these English-speaking stakeholders, which is inherent to this position, it is not possible to reorganize the company's activities to avoid this requirement.

* Experience with Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, WebdriverIO, or other modern automation tools.
* Exposure to API testing tools such as Postman, Insomnia, or equivalent technologies.

jobs.description:
**Job Information**
  
Job Requisition ID: 88284
  
Ministry: Technology and Innovation
  
Location: Edmonton
  
Full or Part-Time: Full-Time
  
Hours of Work: 36.25 hours per week
  
Permanent/Temporary/Wage: Permanent
  
Scope: Open Competition
  
Closing Date: October 13, 2026
  
Classification: Systems Analyst 1
  
Salary: $2,533.72 to $3,799.96 bi-weekly ($66,130 - $99,178/year)

  

The Alberta Public Service works to build a stronger province for current and future generations. We make a difference in the lives of Albertans through rewarding and diverse career opportunities.

  

Technology and Innovation is responsible for making innovation and technology the driving force behind Alberta’s economic growth and diversification.

  

The Digital Design and Delivery (DDD) division is the Government of Alberta’s centre of digital delivery. It partners with ministries to design simpler, faster, and better services; build capability and confidence in modern digital practices; and assure service quality and value through standards and controls. Multidisciplinary product teams are assigned priority GoA projects and employ an agile, product-oriented approach in providing solutions for ministry partners.

  

Within DDD, the Software Delivery Branch provides architectural leadership, CloudOps, DevOps practices, quality engineering, and software delivery excellence across product and platform teams. The Digital Architect plays a key role in shaping how digital solutions are designed, evolved, and governed, balancing innovation with reliability, security, and public sector responsibility.

**Role Responsibilities**
-------------------------

The Software Delivery branch is looking for six (6) Junior Full Stack Developers (FSD). Reporting to the Director, Software Development, this role supports the team in the design and implementation of software with a focus on iterative, continuous development, where requirements and solutions evolve through collaboration between cross-functional teams and users.

  

This role explicitly requires AI capability, creating systems with AI as a co-developer. So, we are seeking developers who can build, integrate, and optimize AI-driven solutions in addition to traditional front-end and back-end development.

  

The responsibilities of this role include:

* Develop and maintain front-end and back-end solutions, including AI-enabled features and digital services.
* Collaborate with agile teams, stakeholders, and users to design, build, and improve digital products.
* Contribute to backlog planning, effort estimation, and the delivery of high-quality software features.
* Apply development best practices, including testing, code reviews, CI/CD automation, and source control.
* Research emerging technologies and AI tools to identify opportunities for innovation and service improvement.
* Provide technical support and recommendations while communicating solutions effectively to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  

To be successful in this position, you will demonstrate:

* Ability to self-learn a variety of software tools.
* Ability to keep up with industry standards and new tools or resources.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  

The Job Description is provided for Further details on this position

**APS Competencies**
--------------------

Competencies are behaviors that are essential to reach our goals in serving Albertans. We encourage you to have an in depth understanding of the competencies that are required for this opportunity and to be prepared to demonstrate them during the recruitment process.

  

* **Builds Collaborative Environment**: Engages diverse stakeholders and fosters collaboration through shared resources and inclusive dialogue. Resolves conflict through facilitation and coaching while valuing different perspectives to achieve outcomes.
* **Creative Problem Solving:** Uses diverse approaches to analyze problems and generate solutions. Encourages collaboration and brings the right people together to resolve issues.
* **Agility:** Adapts quickly to changing priorities and incorporates improvements into work. Stays composed under pressure and helps others adjust to change.
* **Develop Self and Others:** Builds individual and team capability through learning and development. Promotes shared learning and supports personal development planning.
* **Systems Thinking:** Considers broader trends, risks, and context when making decisions. Aligns actions with organizational goals and addresses barriers to progress.

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Requirements:**

* A related two-year diploma in computer technology or a related discipline from a recognized post-secondary institution.
* Knowledge of software engineering best practices, including secure, scalable application development, testing, CI/CD, DevOps, monitoring, source control, code reviews, and the full software development lifecycle.).
* A cover letter clearly demonstrating relevant skills and competencies tailored to this position.
  

**Equivalencies:**

* A related one-year certificate from a recognized post-secondary institution and one (1) year of related experience.
  

**Assets:**

* Experience designing, developing, and supporting modern full-stack applications using front-end technologies, back-end services, REST APIs, microservices, cloud platforms, databases, and scalable enterprise architectures.
* Experience developing, integrating, and supporting AI-powered applications using modern frameworks, APIs, cloud services, automation platforms, and AI-enabled solutions.
* Knowledge of AI software engineering practices, including responsible AI principles, governance requirements, secure development, deployment, monitoring, API integration, and enterprise technology standards.
* Demonstrated ability to leverage AI and automation technologies to solve business problems, improve efficiency and user experience, and collaborate effectively wi

jobs.title: Full Stack Developer - Golang & Nodejs
jobs.description:
CGI is seeking an experienced Full Stack Developer to join our team and help design, build, and evolve production-grade backend systems and cloud-native platforms. This role is ideal for a senior software professional with deep expertise in Go, strong Node.js development experience, and a solid understanding of AWS cloud services, CI/CD, and engineering automation. As a key member of the engineering team, you will contribute to the architecture, development, deployment, and operational excellence of scalable backend services while collaborating closely with cross-functional teams to deliver secure, reliable, and high-performing solutions. Beyond technical expertise, we are looking for someone who brings sound engineering judgment, challenges assumptions constructively, and helps elevate team decision-making through thoughtful collaboration and technical leadership. This is a full-time permanent opportunity.

**Your future duties and responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services and distributed systems using Go.
* Contribute to full-stack application development using Node.js and React.
* Design and implement secure, reliable REST APIs and backend services.
* Build, maintain, and optimize cloud-native solutions using AWS services and modern cloud engineering practices.
* Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, and engineering tooling.
* Create and maintain Bash scripts and automation solutions to improve development and operational efficiency.
* Collaborate with architects, developers, product owners, and business stakeholders to deliver high-quality software solutions.
* Participate in architecture reviews, code reviews, technical design discussions, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Identify technical risks, performance bottlenecks, and architectural improvements early in the software development lifecycle.
* Mentor team members, promote engineering best practices, and contribute to technical documentation and knowledge sharing.

**Required qualifications to be successful in this role**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Significant professional experience developing enterprise backend or platform solutions.
* Strong hands-on experience developing production-grade backend services using Go.
* Experience with full-stack or backend development using Node.js.
* Experience developing modern web applications using React.
* Strong understanding of AWS cloud services and cloud-native application development.
* Experience designing, implementing, and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation.
* Strong scripting experience using Bash or similar scripting languages.
* Experience designing and developing REST APIs and scalable distributed systems.
* Experience working within Agile software development environments.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.
* Ability to communicate technical trade-offs effectively, work independently, and contribute positively to technical discussions and decision-making.

  
Assets  
The following qualifications would be considered assets:  

* Experience with distributed systems, platform engineering, or cloud infrastructure.
* Experience working with both legacy and modern cloud-native architectures.
* Experience with container technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Experience improving software reliability, observability, and operational excellence.
* Experience mentoring software developers and providing technical leadership.
* Experience working within financial services or other highly regulated industries.

  
CGI is providing a reasonable estimate of the pay range for this role. The determination of this range includes factors such as skill set level, geographic market, experience and training, and licenses and certifications. Compensation decisions depend on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $85,000-$145,000 CAD. This role is an existing vacancy.  
  
#LI-HG

**Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action.**  
  
Life at CGI is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you’ll reach your full potential because…  
  
You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. That’s why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company’s strategy and direction.  
  
Your work creates value. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise.  
  
You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons.  
  
At CGI, we value the strength that diversity brings and are committed to fostering a workplace where everyone belongs. We collaborate with our clients to build more inclusive communities and empower all CGI partners to thrive. That same commitment to fairness extends to how we use technology. To support our recruitment team, AI tools may be used to help assess applications though they never replace human judgement. All hiring decisions remain entirely in the hands of our recruitment professionals.

jobs.title: Développeur.se de logiciels - Flux de travaux agentifs / Software Developer - Agentic Workflows
jobs.description:
Description & Requirements

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

« Pour visualiser la description de poste en français, veuillez sélectionner le français dans le menu déroulant au haut de la page. »

At EA, we believe games are powerful because they bring together multiple ways people engage: play, watch, create, and connect. And increasingly, the biggest entertainment platforms aren't just places to consume content — they're places where communities build.

Creator-made content is already a proven part of EA's history — from community creation tools in Battlefield to The Gallery in The Sims 4. We believe new creative technologies and tools will expand how players engage with and contribute to our experiences, supported by thoughtful product design, safety systems, and global reach. Our focus is on enabling more players to participate in creative expression by making creation easier, safer, and more rewarding.

As a Software Developer, you will help build the agentic harness that turns intent into working games and the loop that lets an agent write, run, evaluate, and repair its own work.

This is a hybrid role, onsite three days a week, in Redwood City, Montreal, or Vancouver.

Responsibilities

You will build and extend an agentic harness for game logic generation, covering tool orchestration, context management, and integration of these capabilities into the engine.
You will partner with engine developers, integrating creator-focused systems into our core engine architecture to enable generative creation workflows.
You will implement guardrails including sandboxed execution, permissioned tool access, content-safety and IP checks, and human review points before generated content reaches players.
You will build evaluation for agent output, including whether a generated game compiles, loads, holds frame rate, and matches intent, and turn those checks into automated regression suites that gate harness changes.
You will partner with researchers, developers, artists, and designers to translate prototypes into production-ready engine features, ensuring alignment with existing systems.
You will design extensible interfaces that allow rapid iteration on new technologies while maintaining architectural integrity and developer usability.
You will define how you productize new technologies within the engine, influencing architecture and creator experience.

Qualifications

3+ years of software development experience with AAA game engines (e.g., Frostbite, Unity, Unreal, Godot, or proprietary)
Expertise in C++
Experience with Python
Experience with agentic harnesses and workflows (Claude Code, Codex, Opencode)
Experience with context engineering, graph engineering, and long running workflow orchestration
Experience with one or more game engine development domains (e.g., gameplay, simulation, systems, content pipelines, and performance-critical systems)

We want to connect you with job opportunities that align with your interests, skills, and expertise. When you create an EA Careers Account and are logged into the portal, you can click “Get Recommendations” to view a curated list of job openings. These recommendations are enhanced by automated processing, including artificial intelligence, and take into account your skills and experience. However, all employment decisions are made by our hiring teams, not by automated systems.

Pay Transparency - North America

Compensation And Benefits

The ranges listed below are what EA in good faith expects to pay applicants for this role in these locations at the time of this posting. If you reside in a different location, a recruiter will advise on the applicable range and benefits. Pay offered will be determined based on a number of relevant business and candidate factors (e.g. education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, or business needs).

PAY RANGES

British Columbia (depending on location e.g. Vancouver vs. Victoria) *$104,500 - $142,800 CAD
California (depending on location e.g. Los Angeles vs. San Francisco) *$120,600 - $184,000 USD

Pay is just one part of the overall compensation at EA.

In the US, we offer a package of benefits including paid time off (3 weeks per year to start), 80 hours per year of sick time, 16 paid company holidays per year, 10 weeks paid time off to bond with baby, medical/dental/vision insurance, life insurance, disability insurance, and 401(k) to regular full-time employees. Certain roles may also be eligible for bonus and other incentive programs.

For Canada, we offer a package of benefits including vacation (3 weeks per year to start), 10 days per year of sick time, paid top-up to EI/QPIP benefits up to 100% of base salary when you welcome a new child (12 weeks for maternity, and 4 weeks for parental/adoption leave), extended health/dental/vision coverage, life insurance, disability insurance, retirement plan to regular full-time employees. Certain roles may also be eligible for bonus and other incentive programs.

About Electronic Arts

We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth.

We adopt a holistic approach to our benefits programs, emphasizing physical, emotional, financial, career, and community wellness to support a balanced life. Our packages are tailored to meet local needs and may include healthcare coverage, mental well-being support, retirement savings, paid time off, family leaves, complimentary games, and more. We nurture environments where our teams can always bring their best to what they do.

jobs.title: AI-Native Mobile QA Engineer
jobs.description:
About Snaplii
Snaplii is a profitable Toronto fintech with 400,000+ users and 500+ brand partners, including Walmart, Costco, DoorDash and Uber. We run one of Canada's most-used payment and rewards wallets, and we are building the payment layer that AI agents use to buy things.

The role
Most of our regression testing is already done by AI. We need someone who can run that setup, decide what it should test next, and catch what it misses. You will be the person who knows whether a release is safe to ship.

You take over a working test process from the person who built it, with a full handover, and a senior engineer on the team is your go-to while you settle in. After that, quality on the Snaplii app is yours. You work every day with our developers on one side and our customer support team on the other.

What you'll do
Test the Snaplii iOS and Android apps before every release, focusing on the flows where mistakes cost money: sign-up and login, top-ups, payments, refunds, and gift card purchase and redemption.
Use AI tools, mainly Claude and Codex, to write test cases, generate test data and keep the automated suites up to date, and check their output instead of trusting it blindly.
Grow our automated mobile tests and choose what is worth automating next.
Turn bugs into reports a developer can fix without asking you anything else, and follow each one until it is closed.
Take issues that users report to support, reproduce them, and explain back to the support team in plain words what happened and when it will be fixed.

What you'll learn
How a payments app is tested when real money moves, including the ugly cases: a payment that goes through twice, a refund that half arrives, a phone that loses signal mid-checkout.
How to build a QA practice where AI does most of the repetitive work and you do the judgement.
How releases, incidents and fixes work end to end in a small team, where you see the whole picture instead of one corner of it.

What we look for
About 1 to 2 years of hands-on QA experience on mobile apps (iOS, Android or both). Co-op and internship work counts.
Some experience with mobile test automation (for example Appium, Maestro, Detox, XCUITest or Espresso) or with AI-based testing. You don't need all of these. We want to see something you built and can talk through.
You already use AI tools in your daily work and can show us how.
You write clearly, and you can explain the same bug to an engineer and to a support agent.
You are patient with repetitive work and you don't let a bug go until it is fixed.
Mandarin and English, professional working proficiency. Our developers and support team work in both, and we verify both in the first call.
Able to work on-site in Etobicoke, Monday to Friday.

Compensation and support
Compensation: CAD $60,000 to $90,000 base salary, depending on experience.
AI tools: you get Claude and Codex, the tools the whole team works with every day, and every employee also has a monthly personal AI tool budget under our AI tools policy.
Immigration support: Snaplii provides LMIA and PNP employer sponsorship for team members who qualify.
Interview: a short screening call in both languages, then a hands-on session. We give you the Snaplii app and a flow to test, you bring whichever AI tools you use, and you show us how you find and report a bug. Then you meet the team.

Notices

We use AI tools to help screen, assess and organize applications. Final hiring decisions are made by people.

Familiarity with regional Canadian French accents beyond Montreal — including Joual and other Québécois varieties

jobs.title: Applied Mathematician - AI Trainer
jobs.description:
DataAnnotation is looking for an experienced mathematician to design mathematical problems that today's leading AI models still get wrong. Models are fluent enough to produce an answer that looks right and a derivation that reads well. You bring the judgment to tell the difference between the two, and the tooling to prove it.

This is a new and growing area for our company, focused on teaching AI to reason correctly rather than plausibly. The work combines deep mathematical knowledge with strong coding skills: you design, test, and validate complex tasks yourself. Your task and your solution become the ground truth a model is scored against, so accuracy is the entire job.

Advantages Of Contracting With Us

You will be able to choose which projects you want to work on and when
You work on your own schedule, on your own computer, from the comfort of your own home
Get access to projects at $40-$125 USD per hour, with bonuses on high-quality work

Responsibilities

Design complex mathematical tasks in your area of expertise
Define what a correct answer looks like and the standard a model has to meet
Test and validate the task yourself before you submit it
Write a step-by-step solution another researcher could reproduce
Design tasks a model cannot solve by replaying a known result, and flag where its reasoning breaks: invalid steps, unstated assumptions, right answers reached by wrong work
Work across numerical analysis, optimization, probability and statistics, applied analysis, and scientific machine learning

Qualifications

Fluency in English (native or bilingual level)
An active research background in mathematics or statistics: advanced graduate student, postdoc, academic researcher, or industry practitioner
Strong coding skills. You write Python and work comfortably at a terminal as part of your research, not as a side interest
Familiarity with reproducible or containerized environments such as Docker is a plus

Note: Payment is made via PayPal. We will never ask for any money from you. PayPal will handle any currency conversions from USD. Only applicants in Australia, Canada, Ireland, New Zealand, the United Kingdom, and the United States will be considered for this role. This is an independent contractor position.

jobs.title: Neuroscientist - AI Trainer
jobs.description:
About The Role

DataAnnotation is looking for experienced bench scientists to evaluate how frontier AI models handle real laboratory work: experimental design, assay QC, troubleshooting a failed run, reading raw instrument output, deciding whether data are usable. You bring the judgment you have built at the bench. We bring the model outputs that judgment is needed to grade.

In this role, you will design challenging, realistic tasks drawn from your own practice, such as a plate QC and go or no go call on a cell based assay, a flow panel gating review, a cloning strategy check, or a Western blot interpretation with the raw images, run them through frontier AI agents, and evaluate what comes back against a professional standard.

You will work with realistic professional files, the kind a scientist in your field actually handles: experimental data, protocols, records, reports and correspondence. Some you will assemble yourself; others will be provided. In every case the goal is the same: a task a competent scientist in your field would complete correctly and a frontier model currently gets wrong.

This is not a traditional lab or analysis role. You will be helping build better AI by putting your knowledge to work in a structured, flexible, fully remote environment. The work is long form and self directed, and clear written reasoning matters as much as technical depth.

Responsibilities

Design challenging, realistic experimental biology tasks drawn from your own day to day workflows: the scenario, a prompt phrased the way you would brief a trusted colleague, and the supporting files an agent would need (plate maps and reader output, instrument exports, gel and blot images, flow summaries, protocols and SOPs, notebook entries, QC records, correspondence), using files you author yourself or files that are provided to you.
Run those tasks through frontier AI agents and evaluate the deliverable they produce (the QC summary, experimental plan, troubleshooting memo, or results workbook) against the standard you would hold a colleague to.
Compare two model outputs on identical prompts and files, decide which performed better, and document where each fell short.
Write detailed grading rubrics that specify what a correct deliverable must contain, such as the right controls checked, the right wells excluded and the right diagnosis of a failed run, and explain in writing why a response passes or fails each one.
Flag concrete failures with evidence: controls ignored or misread, edge effects and outliers missed, wrong normalization to a reference, a plausible sounding troubleshooting story the raw data contradict, fabricated values, ignored files, and off brief interpretation of the ask.
Contribute across molecular and cell biology, protein biochemistry, immunology and flow cytometry, imaging and histology, microbiology and virology, in vivo and preclinical work, and laboratory operations and analytical sciences, and review and refine tasks built by other experts.

Domain Qualifications

3+ years designing and running experiments at a pharma or biotech lab or an academic research lab (counted after undergraduate education).
Depth of experience in at least one of: molecular biology and cloning; cell culture and cell based assays; protein biochemistry; immunology and flow cytometry; imaging and histology; microbiology or virology; in vivo and preclinical work.
Working understanding of several of the other areas above, enough to know what those workflows involve and how they are run (for example, a protein biochemist who also understands how a cell based assay is set up and controlled, and how a flow panel is designed and gated), so you can assess work in adjacent areas and point out what was done correctly or incorrectly.
You have designed and troubleshot experiments, not only executed established SOPs. You can explain what each control is for and diagnose why a run failed.
You generate and QC primary data. You can look at raw instrument output and judge whether a run is usable before anyone makes a figure from it.

General Requirements

Master’s or PhD, or a current PhD candidate, in Biology or a directly related field (molecular or cell biology, genetics, immunology, neuroscience, biochemistry, bioinformatics, or computational biology), completed in the U.S., Canada, Europe, or the UK.
3+ years of hands on experience in your subfield (see Domain qualifications above). Time in an academic lab or research institute counts after undergraduate education.
Able to draw on your own real world experience and day to day workflows to craft scenarios that test whether an AI system can actually do the work.
Hands on practitioner: you currently do (or recently did) the bench or analysis work yourself at an individual contributor level, not solely in a managerial capacity.

jobs.title: Software Engineer (Product - Backend)
jobs.description:
**About Vasco**
---------------

Vasco is the revenue context layer for AI agents. The product was built around one idea: confident is not the same as correct, and revenue decisions get made on confidence all the time. We structure your CRM, billing, calls, and support data into a semantic layer where every metric is sourced, every definition is locked, and every answer is deterministic, then build agents that take the manual busywork off people's plates.

Our cofounders Guillaume and Seb already built and sold one startup together; today they are building the product they wished they had. Vasco's mission is to enable builders and GTM leaders to build a revenue engine that moves the business forward on data they can trust.

Curious how we build? Take a look at our young engineering blog.

**About the role**
------------------

As a Software Engineer at Vasco, you'll build the brain of our agents: the core systems that give them the context, metrics, and playbooks they need to do their job. You'll join a small team of product designers and engineers reporting to our CTO, and work closely with our DevOps, Platform, Data, and Agent teams. The mission is to make GTM agents production-ready: reliable, fast, context-aware, and triggered at the right moment. You'll help shape solutions, then carry them through implementation to release. Twelve months in, winning means our agents run on systems you shaped, shipped, and saw adopted, and you’re able to tackle hard and crunchy problems.

We're open to different levels of seniority. This is not an entry-level position: the problems are hard, the architecture is complex, and you'll own technical decisions and their implementation. We expect high autonomy and accountability at every level, and the scope you own grows with your experience. We'll meet you where you are, and what matters is that you make the team better and more capable of facing complex technical challenges.

We're an early-stage startup working at the frontier of what agents can do in GTM. The path is often foggy, so you should be ready to bring clarity to it with your team, stretch beyond your comfort zone, stay open-minded, and wear more hats than your title suggests. You're AI-forward and you actively contribute to how we work with AI as a team. AI can make engineering lonely, and we push back on that with close collaboration, a fun environment, and a team that stays human.

*For transparency, the internal title for this role is Software Developer.*

**What you will do**
--------------------

* **Backend-focused, full-slice development:** Design, build, and ship the backend behind Vasco, including challenging parts like our context graph and our metric engine, where formula accuracy is key, and own full slices of work, including front end and data visualization when the feature calls for it, with human review sized to the risk.
* **Shaping to adoption:** Shape solutions with designers, engineers, and GTM teammates in our Shape Up process, at the technical level and the business level, turn intent and design into the right context for Claude to implement, then instrument the release and follow adoption with your team.
* **Infrastructure, security, and data trust:** Build services that handle customer revenue data safely and own the infrastructure and security of the parts you build, with guidance and tooling from DevOps, since the product's promise rests on data our customers can trust.
* **AI-native practices:** Help build our backend harness and blueprints, the standards Claude reads so it builds the way we want, so more of your time goes to thinking, technical design, and shaping as AI handles more of the mechanical coding.
* **Incident ownership:** Own your incidents: if you break something in production, you fix it, and you step up for your team the same way, communicating fast and transparently so we know about problems before customers do, because reliability is what we sell.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* **Customer-facing systems.** You've spent at least four years building systems that have touched customers, and your technical decisions trace back to the customer problems they solve.
* **Backend depth.** You've designed, built, and operated production backend services, you design complete systems with the big picture of a feature in mind, and you're comfortable working on a data-heavy infrastructure product like ours. Experience with part of our stack (GCP, BigQuery, Node.js, TypeScript, Terraform) or its equivalents in other clouds is ideal.
* **AI-forward, with healthy skepticism.** You've made AI coding tools central to how you ship, you own and can defend the output you ship, and you build the checks that let you ship with evidence. We'll ask you to show how you run your development lifecycle with AI.
* **High-stakes judgment.** You've made decisions where the cost of being wrong was real, at the scale you've worked at, and you can walk through how you decided.
* **Communication clarity.** You can turn technical trade-offs into clear business impact for any audience, from developers to cofounders.
* **Collaboration.** You've pulled people into your work, you enjoy working as a team, and you contribute to the culture around you.

**What'll make you stand out**
------------------------------

experience. If you are quick to learn, comfortable with AI tools, and like figuring things out on

What You’ll Work On

Core Technologies: C and C++ on Linux, multithreading, and storage systems.
Development Tools: Git, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, code review, and AI coding

assistants.

Learning Opportunities: performance analysis, debugging complex systems, and making

them more reliable and scalable.

without much hand holding.

Engineering, Computer Science, or a similar field.

Good written and verbal communication skills, for code reviews and working in an Agile team.

Preferred Qualifications

Modern C++ (C++11 and later) and the STL.
Multithreaded programming and a basic understanding of concurrency.
Debugging or profiling tools, like gdb, valgrind, or perf.
Familiarity with storage systems, databases, or file I/O.
Understanding of distributed systems or high availability.

What You’ll Learn

Production C and C++ systems: work on systems that run in production and handle real

customer traffic.

Storage and persistence: learn how we persist messages, optimize storage, and keep the system

reliable.

Modern development practices: learn AI-assisted development, CI/CD automation, and testing.
Distributed systems: get exposure to scalability, fault tolerance, and high availability.
Mentorship: work closely with senior engineers who will help you grow.

Why You’ll Love Working at Solace

At AlayaCare, we're more than just a fast-growing SaaS company, we're a team of people passionate about transforming home healthcare. Our cloud-based platform empowers care providers around the world to deliver better outcomes for their clients.

We are seeking a Junior Fullstack Developer (Python) to join our Admission & Marketplace team. You'll contribute to meaningful projects while learning modern development practices, tools, and workflows, and be supported by mentors who will help you develop both your technical abilities and professional skills. With the Marketplace offering, extend the future of collaboration between care providers. Unlock new markets, reduce administrative effort, and strengthen partnerships across the home care ecosystem.

Assist in designing, coding, testing, and debugging software features.

Pair-program with senior developers and participate in code reviews to learn best practices.

Work With Purpose

At AlayaCare, you'll help build technology that empowers care providers and improves outcomes for patients and families. Every line of code and every customer interaction contributes to making care more connected, accessible, and human.

Que vous soyez en début de carrière ou un(e) expert(e) chevronné(e), AlayaCare vous offre l'opportunité de faire grandir votre impact, vos compétences et votre carrière.

À propos du rôle

Nous recherchons un Développeur full-stack junior (Python) afin de rejoindre notre équipe Admission & Marketplace d'AlayaCare Cloud. Cette équipe simplifie les références, la coordination de l'accueil et la planification des soins, tout en permettant aux fournisseurs de collaborer entre agences. En éliminant les processus manuels comme les appels téléphoniques et les télécopies, et en permettant aux agences de sous-traiter efficacement, ces outils accélèrent la planification, renforcent les partenariats et améliorent les résultats pour les entreprises, les travailleurs de la santé et les client(e)s.

Du côté de l'admission des clients, contribuez à transformer la façon dont les références de soins à domicile sont reçues, traitées et coordonnées grâce à un processus d'admission entièrement repensé et fondé sur des capacités d'IA agentique. Simplifiez les opérations d'admission, réduisez le travail manuel et aidez les agences à intégrer les clients aux services de soins plus rapidement, améliorant ainsi l'efficacité des équipes de soins et les résultats pour les clients.

Avec l'offre Marketplace, contribuez à façonner l'avenir de la collaboration entre les fournisseurs de soins. Participer à la conception, au codage, aux tests et au débogage des fonctionnalités logicielles.

Rédiger et maintenir des tests automatisés avec l'encadrement des membres de l'équipe.
Aider à investiguer, reproduire et résoudre les bogues sous supervision.
Participer aux rituels d'équipe tels que les mêlées quotidiennes, les démonstrations et les rétrospectives.
Apprendre et appliquer des pratiques de développement modernes, notamment le développement assisté par l'IA, l'intégration et le déploiement continus (CI/CD), la conteneurisation et la surveillance.

1-2 ans+ d'expérience professionnelle en génie logiciel.
Connaissance d'au moins un langage de programmation (par exemple, Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, ou similaire).
Intérêt démontré pour les outils d'IA, avec une approche proactive pour les intégrer au travail quotidien afin d'accroître l'efficacité et l'innovation.

Excellentes compétences en communication et capacité à collaborer avec des collègues techniques et non techniques.

Chez AlayaCare, vous aiderez à concevoir une technologie qui donne des moyens aux fournisseurs de soins et qui améliore les résultats pour les patient(e)s et leurs familles. jobs.description:
Company Description

Alair Homes is a premium custom home building and large-scale renovation/remodeling company with over 100 franchise locations across Canada and United States.

Alair Homes is a fast-growing, energetic company that is continuously looking for driven and enthusiastic individuals to join our ever-growing team. Successful candidates are hungry to learn and take on new responsibilities. Our diverse organizational culture focuses on people coming together to help build and support the most valuable, lowest risk, highest reward construction companies in the world!

'Living Better Starts Here' runs through all aspects of our business and focuses not only on our esteemed clients but all members of our team. Alair Homes thrives on a unique service delivery system combining custom contracting with a franchise business model and is the largest North American home building franchise.

Alair Team members are engaged, determined, and disciplined in helping develop our franchise partners' businesses to new heights and successes. Since being founded in Nanaimo in 2007, we have grown exponentially across North America, while maintaining our family-oriented, collaborative style of business.
Learn more about Alair at www.alairhomes.com

Job Description

This position is within the Technology department for Home Office.

This position is home based and will be interacting with a team spread across Canada and United States.

We are looking for a Test Automation Developer with strong Playwright and JavaScript/TypeScript skills to join the APEX Product Team. APEX is our internal platform: a React/TypeScript Single Page Application backed by PHP Laravel APIs that communicate with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central. You will own and grow our automated test suite across the UI, Backend APIs, and the flow of data back into Business Central, so the team can ship quickly and with confidence.

This role is open to developers early in their career. If you have around two years of hands-on test automation with JavaScript/TypeScript and Playwright, we want to hear from you.

How We Work

We operate in a Product Operating Model: small empowered teams, outcome-focused goals, and continuous discovery. Quality is a shared responsibility. Developers write tests first on business logic and critical UI flows, and you partner with Developers and Product/Design to turn Acceptance Criteria into test cases, decide where each test belongs, and keep feedback loops fast.

Key Responsibilities

Design, build, and maintain end-to-end test automation in Playwright across APEX modules, APIs, and Business Central integration points.
Take ownership of the existing automation: review it, refactor it, and remove flakiness and duplication.
Decide where coverage matters most using a risk-based approach, focusing on critical paths and high-impact areas.
Keep tests isolated with independent data per test and no cascading failures between apps.
Validating reported defects, and creating well-documented tickets that enable efficient debugging and resolution by development teams
Work with Developers on the handoff from Acceptance Criteria to test cases, and review test code in pull requests.
Integrate the suite into CI so it runs reliably, in parallel, and gives the team fast, trustworthy feedback.
Actively look for leverage: automation, reuse, modularity, documentation, self-serve tools.

Core Competencies and Required Skills and Experience

Test Automation (non-negotiable): Proven experience with test automation using JavaScript.
Playwright: Strong experience with locator-based (web-first) assertions and multi-project configurations.
JavaScript​: Comfortable writing it daily, and able to read and reason about both UI and API code.
API Testing: Solid experience testing REST APIs, ideally a Laravel backend. You call endpoints directly for setup and contract tests, and you know when the UI is actually the thing under test.
Risk-Based Coverage: You prioritize critical paths and high-impact areas rather than chasing coverage numbers.-
Test Design Judgment: You can explain the difference between types and benefits of different tests, and appropriateness for a situation.
Teamwork and Communication: Excellent collaboration and communication skills. Comfortable pairing with Developers, giving and receiving feedback in code review, and explaining quality risks to non-technical stakeholders.

Nice-to-Have Skills

TypeScript: Ability to read and reason about Types, Safety, and proper use.
Experience testing ERP or other stateful back-office systems, especially Business Central, including API-first setup (OData / custom API pages) and isolated test companies.
PHP / Laravel backend familiarity.
CI/CD experience (GitHub Actions or similar) and running tests in parallel.
Exposure to Product Management or Design practices.
Familiarity with the Construction industry, Franchise models, and Construction Project Management.
Interest in evaluating AI features (AI evals).

What Success Looks Like

30 Days:
Environment set up, pairing with the team to onboard, understanding domain basics, and a first review of the existing automation.
60 Days:
Contributing test code to the main branch regularly, with a clear plan for refactoring the existing suite.
90 Days:
One module fully covered by automated E2E tests (for example, the Invoices Module: Backend APIs and UI through to Business Central), and the existing automation refactored and cleaned up.
6 Months:
The APEX Product Team ships meaningfully faster because of reliable, trusted test automation.
1 Year+:
Helping define and build evaluation (AI evals) for AI features in our products.

Compensation:
$90,000 – $100,000 CAD per year

Full-time, Permanent, Remote

Early Careers: Junior C#/ SQL Developer & Data Analytics

Are you curious about the Insurance industry? Interested in working with a team of experts who are generous with sharing their knowledge, and joining an industry leading, highly inclusive organization? This could be the perfect opportunity for you!

This is a hybrid role with the flexibility to work both virtually and from our Montreal office.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in Canada. This role is not eligible for sponsorship, and we are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa or work permit.

Aon is in the business of better decisions

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

What The Day Will Look Like

Maintaining and enhancing our in‑house applications built primarily with C#, .NET and Microsoft SQL Server, including adding new features, improving usability, and solving bugs raised by users.
Fulfilling ad‑hoc data requests from colleagues by writing and optimizing SQL queries to extract, validate and format information from our systems for business, operational and reporting needs.
Building and supporting automation solutions (mail merge, Excel macros, C# utilities and SQL Server scripts) that streamline office workflows and improve efficiency.
Acting as a liaison between business users and Aon IT, helping to translate user requirements into technical requests (e.g., application changes, folder or network access, permission updates).
Partnering with Aon IT teams to coordinate and test system upgrades, patches and infrastructure changes, ensuring our C#/.NET and SQL Server–based applications remain stable and available with minimal downtime.
Developing and maintaining business reports (for example, attendance and other key performance or operational reports) using tools such as Crystal Reports, Excel and SQL Server.
Documenting changes, processes and user guides to support knowledge transfer and provide clear references for both technical teams and non‑technical users.
Participating in regular team meetings to discuss priorities, review upcoming work, and contribute ideas for improving our systems and processes

How This Opportunity Is Different

This role provides an opportunity to observe the full lifecycle of internal tools and applications, from understanding end‑user needs through composing, build, testing, deployment and ongoing support. You will have direct contact with business users, giving you a clear view of how your work improves efficiency and supports critical day‑to‑day operations. You will be working for a business unit supporting high profile clients in the professional services industries, operating in multiple insurance markets (US, UK, Bermuda, Canada) and will have the chance to interact with people from all those locations.

We are a small team, you will gain broad, hands‑on experience across application development, data/reporting, automation and basic infrastructure coordination rather than being limited to a narrow specialization. You will work closely with experienced colleagues in both the business and Aon IT, with opportunities for mentorship, on‑the‑job learning and exposure to enterprise‑grade tools and environments.

The systems you support are important to our business; you will quickly see the impact of your work and be encouraged to propose and implement improvements.

Êtes-vous curieux d’en savoir plus sur le secteur de l’assurance? Vous souhaitez travailler avec une équipe d’experts qui n’hésitent pas à partager leurs connaissances et rejoindre une organisation leader dans son secteur et très inclusive? Cela pourrait être pour vous l’occasion rêvée!

Il s’agit d’un poste hybride qui offre la possibilité de travailler à la fois virtuellement et à notre bureau de Montréal.

Les candidats doivent être légalement autorisés à travailler au Canada. Ce poste n’est pas admissible au parrainage et nous ne sommes pas en mesure de parrainer un candidat ou de participer à son parrainage pour l’obtention d’un visa d’emploi ou d’un permis de travail.

Aon a pour vocation de favoriser une meilleure prise de décisions

Chez Aon, nous contribuons à une meilleure prise de décisions afin de protéger et d’enrichir la vie des gens dans le monde entier.

En tant qu’organisation, nous sommes unis par la confiance en une équipe inclusive et nous sommes passionnés par la réussite de nos employés et de nos clients.

À quoi vous attendre au quotidien

Assurer la maintenance et l’amélioration de nos applications internes conçues avec C#, .NET et SQL Server, notamment en ajoutant de nouvelles fonctionnalités, en améliorant la convivialité et en corrigeant les bogues signalés par les utilisateurs.
Répondre aux demandes ponctuelles de données des employés en extrayant, en validant et en formatant l’information provenant de nos systèmes pour répondre aux besoins opérationnels, d’affaires et de production de rapports.
Concevoir et soutenir des solutions d’automatisation (publipostage, macros Excel, utilitaires C#, requêtes Access, scripts SQL) qui rationalisent les flux de travail au bureau et améliorent l’efficacité.
Agir comme intermédiaire entre les utilisateurs d’affaires et les services de TI d’Aon, en aidant à traduire les besoins des utilisateurs en demandes techniques (p. ex. modifications d’applications, accès à des dossiers ou au réseau, mises à jour des autorisations).
Travailler en partenariat avec les équipes de TI d’Aon pour coordonner et tester les mises à niveau des systèmes, les correctifs et les changements d’infrastructure, afin de garantir que nos applications demeurent stables et disponibles avec un minimum d’interruptions.
Élaborer et maintenir des rapports opérationnels (par exemple, des rapports de présence et d’autres rapports clés de rendement ou opérationnels) à l’aide d’outils comme Crystal Reports, Excel et SQL.
Documenter les changements, les processus et les guides de l’utilisateur afin de favoriser le transfert des connaissances et d’offrir des références claires tant pour les équipes techniques que pour les utilisateurs non techniques.
Participer aux réunions d’équipe régulières pour discuter des priorités, examiner le travail à venir, et proposer des idées pour améliorer nos systèmes et nos processus.

En quoi cette offre d’emploi est-elle différente des autres?

Ce poste offre l’occasion d’observer le cycle de vie complet des outils et applications internes, depuis la compréhension des besoins des utilisateurs finaux jusqu’à la conception, la création, les tests, le déploiement et le soutien continu. Vous serez en contact direct avec les utilisateurs de l’entreprise, ce qui vous donnera une vision claire de la façon dont votre travail améliore l’efficacité et soutient les opérations quotidiennes essentielles. Vous travaillerez pour une unité fonctionnelle qui soutient des clients de premier plan dans le secteur des services professionnels, actifs sur plusieurs marchés d’assurance (États Unis, Royaume Uni, Bermudes, Canada), et vous aurez l’occasion d’interagir avec des personnes de tous ces lieux.

Nous formons une petite équipe; vous acquerrez une vaste expérience pratique en développement d’applications, en gestion des données et des rapports, en automatisation et en coordination de base de l’infrastructure, plutôt que d’être limité à une spécialisation étroite. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec des employés chevronnés, tant au sein de l’entreprise qu’au sein des équipes de TI d’Aon, et bénéficierez d’occasions de mentorat, d’apprentissage en cours d’emploi et d’une exposition à des outils et des environnements de calibre entreprise.

Les systèmes que vous soutiendrez sont importants pour nos activités; vous verrez rapidement l’incidence de votre travail et serez encouragé à proposer et à mettre en œuvre des améliorations.

Grand sens du jugement et excellentes aptitudes de présentation professionnelle.

This flexible, remote opportunity allows you to apply your analytical and research skills to evaluate search results and AI-generated content while contributing to the development of high-quality AI systems.
A Day in the Life of a Quality Assurance Rater
In this role, you'll conduct analytical assessments of search results and AI responses, providing ratings and feedback that help improve AI model performance and search quality.
Your work will maintain high quality standards and deliver the accuracy our clients depend on.
You'll evaluate a variety of rating tasks, analyze content with attention to detail, conduct research to support rating decisions, and identify guideline gaps or task inconsistencies.
You'll also participate in training and calibration sessions while contributing feedback to improve rating processes and guidelines.
Key Responsibilities
Evaluate search results and AI-generated content for quality, relevance, accuracy, and usefulness.
Conduct online research to verify information and support rating decisions.
Apply rating guidelines consistently while maintaining quality standards.
Document edge cases, guideline gaps, and task-related issues.
Provide clear written feedback and rationale for ratings when required.
Participate in training, calibration sessions, and ongoing quality reviews.
Meet productivity expectations while maintaining high-quality work.
The hourly earnings for this role are 18 EUR per hour, payment is based on completed tasks.
TELUS Digital AI Community
Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of 1 million+ contributors from diverse backgrounds who help our customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and make an impact supporting the machine learning models of some of the world’s largest brands.
Qualification path
Candidates will complete project-specific training and qualification assessments before joining the program. Ongoing work will be subject to regular quality assurance reviews and performance monitoring.
Basic Requirements
Working as a freelancer with excellent communication skills in Spanish & English.
Resident in Spain for the last 5 consecutive years.
Familiarity with current and historical business, media, sports, news, social media, and cultural affairs.
Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and research skills.
Experience using web browsers, search engines, and online research tools.
Daily access to a reliable broadband internet connection, smartphone, and personal computer.
Demonstrated research capability through professional background OR strong track record of self-directed research and information verification
Ability to work independently and follow detailed guidelines consistently.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Athennian**


Athennian delivers Governance Ops™ software that aligns legal, finance, tax and fund teams through a secure, integrated source of truth for entity and ownership data. The platform enables organizations managing complex corporate and investment structures to automate governance workflows, maintain audit\-ready records and collaborate across functions with confidence.  

  

More than 500,000 entities across over 150 countries are managed on Athennian, helping organizations modernize entity management and transform governance operations into a strategic advantage.  

  

We are a fast\-moving, solutions\-driven team using an AI\-forward approach to solve complex operational challenges. If you are passionate about building technology that transforms traditional industries, we’d love to have you join us.

 **About the role**


We're looking for a driven **Software Engineer** to join our dynamic engineering team to contribute to our mission of managing hundreds of thousands of business entities worldwide, empowering our users with a platform that inspires trust. In this role, you will contribute to designing, building, and maintaining scalable software solutions that enhance our platform's functionality and performance. Reporting to the Sr Engineering Manager, you will collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams to deliver high\-quality full\-stack solutions, while leading the integration and operation of production AI features (such as RAG, intelligent search, LLM integrations, or agents).

 **What you'll do**

* **Architect \& Deliver:** Develop, test, and deploy high\-quality, scalable software solutions that align with complex business needs.
* **Strategic System Design:** Participate in technical discussions and contribute to high\-level decisions on system architecture, focusing on configurability and long\-term maintainability.
* **Ship Production AI Features:** Lead the design, implementation, and maintenance of real\-world AI capabilities (e.g., RAG systems, vector search, LLM integrations, and autonomous agents) directly into our customer\-facing product.
* **AI\-Augmented Development:** Leverage modern AI\-assisted development tools to accelerate delivery cycles while maintaining code integrity.
* **Collaborative Innovation:** Work closely with product managers, designers, and other engineers to translate user needs into innovative features and improvements.
* **Quality \& Security Governance:** Optimize application performance, ensure security and reliability, and conduct thorough code reviews to maintain high code quality.
* **Process Evolution:** Identify and resolve technical challenges, propose solutions, and contribute to the continuous improvement of our development processes.
* **Future\-Proofing:** Stay up to date with industry trends, specifically LLM integrations and automated testing advancements to evaluate and adopt emerging technologies that can enhance our platform’s capabilities.
* **Technical Mentorship**: Guide the team in best practices for modern engineering, from sophisticated TypeScript typing to efficient AI\-prompting for complex refactors.

 **Qualifications**

* **5\+ years of software engineering** experience building scalable, enterprise\-grade applications.
* **Startup/Scale\-Up Background:** Experience navigating fast\-paced software startup environments where shipping and iterating quickly is essential.
* **Production AI Experience:** Proven track record of shipping and operating real\-world AI features in a live product (e.g., RAG, LLM integrations, vector search, or AI agents) not just using AI coding tools.
* **Full\-Stack Proficiency:** Strong expertise in JavaScript/TypeScript environments, specifically the MEAN stack (MongoDB, Express, Angular, Node.js).
* **Modern Tooling \& Testing:** Fluent with AI\-assisted coding tools (Cursor, Copilot), automated testing (Jest, Cypress, Playwright), CI/CD, and cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP/Azure, Docker).

 **Nice to Have Skills:**

* **Databases \& Vector Search:** Solid relational/NoSQL foundation alongside experience with vector search (e.g., MongoDB Atlas Vector Search) or search indexing.
* **Security \& Communication:** Security\-first mindset for handling sensitive corporate data and the ability to explain technical/AI trade\-offs to non\-technical partners.

 **Location**


We have embraced a distributed model of working to reach the best talent in the world. While some roles may require proximity to our Toronto, Calgary and Vancouver offices, roles based outside our office locations can be remote in Canada. Please only apply if you are able to live and work full\-time in Canada. **\#LI\-Remote**

 **Our Culture**


Our company thrives in a fast\-paced startup environment where every team member plays a critical role in driving success.

**Outcome Driven:** We focus on setting ambitious goals and achieving measurable results.

**Wide Responsibility:** Our team is empowered to take ownership from problem identification to implementation.

**Learning Mindset:** We embrace curiosity and reject the status quo.

**Strategic Speed:** We make fast, effective decisions and embrace a bias for action.

 **Benefits at Athennian**


We’re a remote\-first company built on trust, autonomy, and accountability.

**Work\-Life Balance:** Minimum of 3 weeks vacation, 5 sick days, and 6 personal/flex days, plus a company\-wide winter holiday shutdown.

**Comprehensive Coverage:** Health, dental, and vision, long\-term disability, and a Health Spending Account (HSA).

**Family Support:** Flexible parental leave benefits, including top\-ups.

**Remote Setup:** A dedicated work\-from\-home allowance to get you set up for success.

 **The pay range for this role is:**  

90,000 \- 130,000 CAD per year(Remote (Canada))

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) - GenAI / Agentic AI
jobs.description:
Tiger Analytics is looking for experienced **Forward Deployed Engineer** with Gen AI experience to join our fast\-growing advanced analytics consulting firm. Our employees bring deep expertise in Machine Learning, Data Science, and AI. We are the trusted analytics partner for multiple Fortune 500 companies, enabling them to generate business value from data. Our business value and leadership has been recognized by various market research firms, including Forrester and Gartner.


We are looking for top\-notch talent as we continue to build the best global analytics consulting team in the world.
  

  

**Role Overview:**  

  

We're looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer who thrives at the intersection of client problem\-solving and hands\-on AI engineering. You'll partner directly with clients and engineering teams to turn complex business challenges into production\-grade GenAI and Agentic AI solutions — owning the journey from first conversation to live deployment.

 **Requirements**  

* Partner directly with clients to understand complex business problems and translate them into GenAI and Agentic AI solutions.
* Design, build, deploy, and scale LLM applications, RAG systems, AI agents, and multi\-agent workflows.
* Integrate AI solutions with enterprise data, APIs, databases, and business applications.
* Deploy, operate, and scale solutions in production cloud environments.
* Troubleshoot and optimize production systems for performance, scalability, reliability, security, and cost.
* Collaborate closely with architects, ML engineers, developers, and client stakeholders in fast\-moving, ambiguous environments.

**Qualifications:**

**Engineering Foundation**

* 7\+ years in software engineering, application development, ML engineering, or AI engineering.
* Strong Python programming skills.
* Solid grasp of APIs, system design, databases, cloud\-native applications, and production deployments.
* JavaScript/TypeScript experience is a plus.

**GenAI / Agentic AI Expertise**

* Proven experience building and deploying end\-to\-end GenAI and/or Agentic AI solutions.
* Hands\-on experience with LLMs — OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, and open\-source models.
* Hands\-on experience with RAG, vector databases, embeddings, tool/function calling, and AI agents.
* Experience with agent orchestration, multi\-agent systems, or agentic workflows.
* Familiarity with frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Google ADK, or similar.
* Working knowledge of MCP, A2A, or similar agent integration protocols.

**Cloud \& Production**

* Hands\-on experience with at least one major hyperscaler — AWS, Azure, or GCP — including targeted expertise in:
* **AWS Stack:** Designing workflows via Amazon Bedrock (Claude, Llama), deploying scalable RAG using OpenSearch Serverless (Vector Engine), and configuring Bedrock Guardrails for client VPCs.
* **Azure Stack:** Deploying enterprise LLMs via Azure OpenAI Service (PTU optimization), building hybrid RAG systems with Azure AI Search, and orchestrating flows using Azure AI Foundry and Semantic Kernel.
* **GCP Stack:** Scaling applications within Vertex AI, managing production pipelines, structuring enterprise RAG with Vertex AI Vector Search \+ BigQuery, and building agentic flows with Gemini APIs.
* Exposure to LLM evaluation, observability, monitoring, guardrails, or LLMOps.

**The FDE Mindset**

* Strong customer\-facing communication and sharp problem\-solving instincts.
* Comfortable operating independently, navigating ambiguity, and moving fast from problem solution production.
* Equally at home with business and technical stakeholders.

 **Benefits**  

This position offers an excellent opportunity for significant career development in a fast\-growing and challenging entrepreneurial environment with a high degree of individual responsibility.

***Tiger Analytics provides equal employment opportunities to applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, pregnancy, national origin, ancestry, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other basis as protected by federal, state, or local law.***

Vantum helps fractional operators win new clients while delivering for the clients they already have. When you’re managing several engagements, client work can consume the week and leave little time to grow your own business. We’re building Vantum to help operators make progress on both.

Interested in telecoms security and keen to build your career in a fast-moving, global environment? We are looking for a Threat Intelligence Analyst to join our Threat Intelligence team in Toronto, reporting to the Head of Threat Intelligence and working closely with experienced analysts across our global team. This is an opportunity to develop your technical and client-facing skills while helping us identify and respond to evolving threats across the telecoms landscape.

Role And Key Responsibilities

Based in Toronto, you will analyse customer deployment data, investigate emerging threats and help maintain security solutions on Enea client platforms. You will take ownership of client questions and security reviews, working independently while supported by regional and global colleagues. Some scheduled Saturday or Sunday shift coverage will form part of the role.

Key responsibilities include:

Create, configure and maintain security solutions on Enea client platforms.
Monitor the telecoms threat landscape and keep your knowledge of relevant security developments current.
Analyse data collected from customer deployments to identify, investigate and document potential threats.
Deliver security reviews for Enea clients, respond independently to client questions and manage expectations.
Communicate findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, including where commercial considerations are relevant.
Work independently on assigned activities while collaborating with regional and global Threat Intelligence colleagues.
Participate in agreed shift coverage, including some Saturday or Sunday work.

Required Qualifications

Qualifications, Key Skills and Competence

BSc degree in Computer Science, Telecommunications or a related technical field.
A strong interest in telecoms and security technology, with curiosity about an evolving threat landscape.
Working knowledge of Unix/Linux environments and basic familiarity with SQL and database concepts.
Knowledge of TCP/IP, HTTP, SMTP and DNS, together with an understanding of GSM network fundamentals.
Strong communication skills in English, with the ability to explain concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
Availability to participate in scheduled weekend shift coverage as required.

Preferred Qualifications

1-3 years of relevant experience in telecoms, cybersecurity, threat intelligence, network or security analysis, or a related technical environment.
Experience with messaging systems and architectures.
Knowledge of shell scripting or a scripting language such as Python, Ruby or Perl.
Experience analysing customer or operational data, investigating security issues or contributing to security reviews.
Experience working in a global, client-facing or fast-moving technical environment.
